dpe skrun gsal bshad/dus rabs gong ma'i lo rabs80pa'i rjes su/ bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig gsar rtsom ni dbyar gyi mtsho mo rgyas pa bzhin gong du 'phel ba'i rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dus skabs shig la bslebs/ phyogs yongs dang 'thus sgo tshang ba'i ngang skabs de'i bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi rnam pa dang chu tshad mngon par mtshon slad/ nged dpe skrun khang gis1991lo dang2001lor snga gzhug byas nas〈 bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig dpe tshogs〉 (pod bcu)dang ( sbrang char lo 'khor20dpe tshogs〉 (pod brgyad)zhes pa gnyis par skrun byas pas spyi tshogs su gdeng 'jog cung legs po thob/ dus rabs21par bslebs pa na/ bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom la sngar byung ma myong ba'i 'phel rgyas kyi gnas tshul legs po byung ste/ dus rabs gong ma'i lo rabs80pa'i smad tsam la rtsom stegs su bud pa'i rtsom pa po skor zhig la mtshon na/ dus rabs gsar ba'i nang du'ang sngar bzhin dungs pa'i tshor rlabs mkha' la 'phyo zhing rtsom pa'i rgyun la nyams pa med par/ 'bras bu'i khur gyis dud pa'i gsar rtsom dang shugs rkyen gyi nus pa srung 'dzin byas thog mu mthud du rang 1
nyid la yar skyed chen po 'byung du bcug ste brtsams chos gsar ba mang bo 'don spel gnang 'dug khong tsho ni bsam gzhig gtong la mkhas shing 'tshol rtog byed la rings pas/ brtsams chos kyi bsam blo'i snying bo sngar las phun sum tshogs pa dang / spyi tshogs kyi don snying mngon pa sngar las gting zab pa/ sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos sngar las gsal zhing gsar bas/ klog pa po'i khrod shugs rkyen cher 'phel ba dang bstun nas/ bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom dpung khrag gi lam sna 'khrid mkhan du gyur 'dug de las kyang dga' 'os pa zhig la/ dus rabs gsar ba'i gom 'gros dang bstun nas bsam blo'i 'khyug shed che zhing gsar gtod kyi blo spobs ldan la/ lta rgya dang thos rgya che ba'i rtsom pa po gsar ba skor zhig char rjes kyi sha mo brdol ba bzhin rtsom stegs kyi gru ga so sor mngon te/ bod kyi rtsom rig dpung sde'i rgyun 'dzin mkhan du grub pas/ bod kyi rtsom rig gom gang mdun spos kyis 'phel rgyas 'gro bar nus stobs gsar ba bsnan par gyur/dus rabs gsar ba'i bod kyi rtsom pa po'i gsar rtsom gyi grub 'bras phyogs yongs nas mngon par mtshon ched/ nga tshos〈 dus rabs21pa'i bod kyi rtsom pa po'i deb phreng〉 zhes pa 'di rtsom sgrig par skrun bya rgyu thag gis bcad/ deb phreng de'i nang du dus rabs gsar ba'i tshun la grub 'bras mngon gsal thob cing / khyad chos 'bur du thon pa/ klog pa po'i khrod shugs rkyen cung che ba'i rtsom pa po dag dmigs su bzung ste/ khong tsho'i brtsams chos la sgo kun nas gsed shad dang phyogs bsdus byas thog legs pa'i legs pa 2

smyug rtse'i bzhur rgyun/des na nga tshos mjal skor zhes pa de tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong gi chos lugs dad mos kho na ma yin par rang cag bod kyi rig gnas la shes rtogs dang zhib 'jug byed mkhan rnams kyi ngos nas bshad na mig mthong lag zin du zhib 'jug byed pa'i thabs bzang zhig yin la/ rang re'i mes po dam pa rnams kyi thos bsam slob gnyer gyi dka' spyad dang / rig gzhung zhib 'jug gi snying stobs/ ma 'ongs par sha zhen gyi rnam dag mdzad spyod bskyangs pa'i lo rgyus dang / mdzad rjes la rgyus lon byed pa'i thabs bzang zhig kyang yin par sems so//
ma jal skor gyi ma thong thos/narma bka' brgyud kyi rtsa ba'i gdan sa chen mo 'og min dpal gyi stod lung mtshur phu ni gangs ljongs lte ba'i grong khyer lha ldan sa yi thig le'i nub phyogs su gnas pa'i lo rgyus yun ring ldan zhing / mtshan snyan gyi grags pa 'dzam gling khyon du khyab pa'i bod kyi rig gnas dang sgyu rtsal gyi 'byung gnas chen mo'i gras shig yin/da lo'i zla1pa'i tshes15nyin res gza' nyi ma dang skabs khol ba'i dus bzang 'dir / kho bo 'du 'dzi che ba'i grong khyer du yun ring bsdad par khams bsang ba'i ched dang / lo rgyus yun ring ldan pa'i gnas mchog 'dir lta tsam byed par 'gro rgyu'i 'dun pa zhig 'gog med yid la 'char/ zhogs par rta bdun dbang po'i 'od snang grong khyer chen po'i gling du ma khyab pa'i gong du rlangs 'khor nang bsdad/ snum nag lam chen mda' ltar drang zhing /shin tu bde ba'i stabs kyis 'grul skyel rlangs 'khor gyi myur tshad gnyis 3
byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/skyes mkha' la bskyod pa'i myur mgyogs las kyang lhag pa lta bu snang la/ bdag gis kyang lam 'gram g.yas g.yon gyi mthong snang gsar pa rnams la 'a dren byed cer bzhin zhogs pa'i gso rlung yang mor rgyu ba'i 'og tu lus sems gnyis ka brjod med kyi dga' ba zhig nyams su myangs/zhogs pa'i chu tshod9pa tsam la mtshur do bo lung gi mdor bslebs skabs/ las la brtson zhing ya rabs gshis bzang gi so nam pa rnams gser mdog gi zhing thang du sna tshogs zhing las kyi bya bar brel bzhin 'dug cing /dpyid kyi dpal yon zhes pa ni mi yul khams kyi snod bcud thams cad la gson shugs gsar pa zhig rgyas pa'i dus yin la/ 'bad brtson gsar par brten nas 'bras bu gsar pa zhig 'thob pa'i sta gon rtsom dus shig yin zhes pa cis ma bden/ las la brtson pa'i so nam pa tshos zhing las la 'bad pa'i bla med kyi brtson 'grus de bzhin du rang cag shes bya sbyong mkhan rnams kyis dpyid dus dang 'dra ba'i gzhon nu'i lang tsho rgyas bzhin pa'i skabs su rang dgos yon tan yid bzhin nor bu len rgyur 'bad pa lhod med byas na /ston dus 'bru rigs sna lngas bang mdzod khongs pa bzhin du nam zhig shes rig yon tan gyi bdag por mi 'gyur ba ci la srid snyam pa'i bsam blo'i go rtogs zab mo zhig kyang che cher skyes byung /gnas mchog de'i khor yug gi bkod pa ni phu dang mda' yi dbye mtshams mi chod par lhun stug pa'i nags ri dang spang ris yongs su bsko ra zhing / shug pa dang / sbyar sdong / se ba/ sur dkar sogs gna' bo'i ljon shing 4
smyug rtse'i bzhur rgyun/mang pos tshang tshing g.yu lo bkod pa lta bu'i dbus su gser 'od lam lam 'phro ba'i rgya phibs dang / g.yang gzar gyi rbab chu 'phyo 'dra'i dar ldi/ sprin dkar sa la nyal 'dra'i gtsug lag khang chen du mas khengs shing / mtshams sprin zhun ma dum bu chad 'dra'i dge 'dun pa brgya phrag mang po dung dang rgya gling sogs rna bar mi zad pa'i dga' ba bskyed pa'i sgra dbyangs kyi rol mo sna tshogs dang lhan du/ ngang pa'i khyu tshogs brgya stong mang po 'tshogs pa'i skad sgrar 'gran pa'i zhal 'don gyis yid la nges 'byung gi bsam pa than thun re 'khor rgyur 'gog thabs ma mchis la/ lung rigs brgal brtag gi rnam dpyod 'phel ba'i bgro gleng la yid smon gyi mthe bong mi sgreng mkhan gcig kyang mi 'dug'og min mtshur phu dgon pa ni/ kurma kram tshang gi grub mtha' gsar btod mkhan po dang bod kyi lo rgyus thog tu sprul sku'i lam lugs srol btod pa po bla chen kurma pa rim byon gyi gdan sa ngo ma de yin par ma zad/ bod kyi thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas rnams la thos bsam slob gnyer bya yul grags can zhig yin la/ bod brgyud nang bstan gyi grub mtha' chen mo bzhi yi ya gyal bka' brgyud pa'i dgon rnying zhig kyang yin pa dang / lo rgyus thog dgon pa de nas thon pa'i mkhas pa mang du byung yod pa ni/ mkhas grub o rgyan pa dang / rgyal ba rang byung rdo rje/ 'jam dbyangs don grub 'od zer/ go shrī dpal 'byor don grub/ kurma chos grags rgya mtsho/ rgyal dbang mi bskyod rdo rje sogs mkhas btsun bzang gsum dang 5
byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi don la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i mkhas pa mang pos skad grags che ba'i rtsom yig〈 dngul chu grub pa'i bstan bcos〉 dang /〈 zab mo nang gi don〉 〈 rtsa rlung 'phrul 'khor rig pa〉 〈 tshad ma kun las btus pa〉 sogs deng skabs 'dzam gling na shugs rkyen che ba'i gzhung chen mang po gnas mchog der brtsams pa yin/gnas mchog 'di ni mi'i rgyu 'grul cung nyung zhing 'du 'dzi che ba'i grong khyer dang bar thag ring ba sogs kyis khu sim mer gnas pa'i dben khrod cig yin stabs/ der slob gnyer byed sa'i khor yug legs pa dang / rnam g.yeng gi yul med pa'i dge mtshan la dmigs nas bzhengs par mngon la/de snga'i bod brgyud nang bstan chos gzhung gi slob gnyer ba rnams rig gnas sbyong rgyu kho nar don gnyer gyis slob gnyer gyi ched du lus dang longs spyod la dka' ngal ci tsam phog kyang ji mi snyam pa'i sgo nas mi rigs kyi rig gzhung 'phel rgyas su gtong ba'i snying stobs rlabs po cher mos gus kyi mgo lcog mi ldem ka med byung /mtshur phu lung pa'i rked pa man tsam gyi ri ldebs su dgon sde chung chung zhig lug khyu thang la bkram pa bzhin dkar 'khyil ler chags 'dug pa ni kurma bka' brgyud kyi bla sprul chen po lnga'i ya gyal dpa' bo sprul sku'i gdan sa gnas nang dgon pa red/ dgon pa de ni phyogs kyi ri bo rnams kyis khor mo yug tu bskor zhing / lhung lhung du 'bab pa'i g.ya' chu bsil ma dang dgon pa'i zur dril gyi sgra mnyam du 'gran pa ltar grags/ sngo ljang gi ljon shing mang 6
smyug rtse'i bzhur rgyun/pos yid la spro snang sbyin pa dang / rlung rta sna lnga'i dar ldi dri bzhon gyis dal bur 'gul ba'i sgra dbyangs rna ba'i bu gar ha cang snyan/ na bun smug sprin gyi klong nas sbrang char zim bur 'jo ba dang / g.yang gzar nas 'phyo ba'i 'bab chu'i gzegs ma phyogs phyogs su 'thor ba dbye ba chod dka' ba'i tshod du mchis/gnas nang dpa' bo sprul sku'i sku phreng 'ga' zhig la mkhas pa'i mtshan snyan shin tu grags che zhing bod kyi rig gnas 'phel rgyas dang lo rgyus zhib 'jug thad rmad du byung ba'i phyag rjes bzhag myong ba dper na/ sku phreng gnyis pa gtsug lag phreng ba mchog gis de snga'i bod kyi lo rgyus thams cad kyi khungs gtugs sa dang kun gyi tshad mar 'dzin rung zhing / grub mtha'i phyogs lhung med par srong bo'i lam nas〈 chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉 zhes pa brtsams gnang yod pa'i nang bod kyi chos lugs dang rig gnas sogs kyi dar tshul zhib rgyas su brjod yod par ma zad/ bod btsan po'i dus rabs dang de'i yar sngon gyi lo rgyus la dpyad gsum tshad ma'i lam nas sgro 'dogs bral ba'i lung rigs kyi dpyad pa mang po'i sgo nas gsal por bstan yod stabs deng skabs mkhas pa kun gyis bsngags brjod kyi me tog gtor bzhin yod la/ gzhan yang〈 rtsis gzhung rin chen gter mdzod〉 dang / 〈 spyod 'jug 'grel chen〉 sogs gzhung chen mang po brtsams gnang mdzad nas bod kyi shes rig 'phel rgyas su gtong ba'i thad la bla na med pa'i phyag rjes bzhag yod/7
byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/thengs 'di'i mjal skor gyis kurma kram tshang gi chos gzhung brgyud pa dang bcas par sngon med kyi shes rtogs rgyus lon byung ba dang / lhag par du chos lugs de'i mkhas pa grags can mang po zhig gi mdzad rjes la shes rtogs cung zad gsal por byed thub byung / des na nga tshos mjal skor zhes pa de tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong gi chos lugs dad mos kho na ma yin par rang cag bod kyi rig gnas la shes rtogs dang zhib 'jug byed mkhan rnams kyi ngos nas bshad na mig mthong lag zin du zhib 'jug byed pa'i thabs bzang zhig yin la/ rang re'i mes po dam pa rnams kyi thos bsam slob gnyer gyi dka' spyad dang / rig gzhung zhib 'jug gi snying stobs/ ma 'ongs par sha zhen gyi rnam dag mdzad spyod bskyangs pa'i lo rgyus dang / mdzad rjes la rgyus lon byed pa'i thabs bzang zhig kyang yin par sems so/ /nyin byed dbang po nub ri'i phang bar gzhol zhing sa gzhi chen mo'i gling du ngam nag gi smig sgyu bkra ba dang / rlangs 'khor gyi 'dren byed 'od zer lam lam du 'phro ba'i dus su lha ldan grong gi dkyil du bslebs shing / nyin gang ma r+sāng gi lcags ri brtsegs te thob shor gyi 'gal 'du'i klong nas lus sems gnyis ka ngal zhing dub pa dang / grong khyer gyi srang lam kun tu khyi dzom bzhin 'khyam 'khyam du nyul bas rkang mthil la na zug 'chor ba'am/ glog rdul gyi dra mig nas rgyus med kyi mi phor mdza' 'phrin skur skur ngang la mig tshosprin dmar por chags pa'i don med kyi ngal ba de 'dra ma yin par/ mthong thos kyi shes bya mang po'i ro bcud dang / gu yangs pa'i yul ljongs la myong 8

char dus kyi byang thang shel tshwa/gnam gshis 'gyur ldog rgod pa'i byang thang khul la mtshon na/ dbyar zla9pa'i nam zla tshes skabs/ mu mtha' med pa'i thang chen dang / mtho rgyu med pa'i ri tshogs phal ba rnams g.yu yi khu ba lan brgyar byugs 'dra'i steng du me tog sna tshogs kyi mdzes sdug dang dri bsung kun tu 'phro zhing / chu shel dkar po'i mchod rten brtsegs 'dra'i gangs ri dang / mthing mdog sbra gur phub 'dra'i rdza ri/ dgung sngon gyi zhal ras ngom pa'i mtsho dang mtshe'u sogs kyang rang rang gi bkrag mdangs nam rgyun las che ba ltar du snang /mdzes sdug phul du byung ba'i rang byung khams chen po de'i steng du mu tig tshom bu lta bu'i lug khyu dang / yos khra thang la bkram 'dra'i ra skyes/ mchong gi phreng ba 'thor 'dra'i nor gnag gi khyu tshogs rnams dbyar gyi sngo ljang ne'u gsing dpal yon la dga' bde'i longs su spyod cing / dngul dkar dril bu dkrol ba'i gdangs la 'gan pa'i 'brog pa'i phyugs rdzi gzhon nu de dag gi 10

byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/sgrub par yong ba dang skabs khel bas/ lo rgyus ring zhing lo gcig dus gcig gi lha sa'i chab zhugs dus chen gtong sar 'khyug tsam 'gro rgyu'i 'dun pa zhig 'gog med yid la 'char/ lha sa'i ston zla7pa'i zla mjug ni gnam gshis tsha grang snyoms le khor yug tshang ma shin tu gu yangs shing lhod shig shig gi snang ba zhig sbyin par byed/ nyi 'od grong khyer du grags pa'i gna' grong gi skyes bu rnams sa mtho'i rang byung khams kyi mdzes pa dang / dwangs gtsang gi mkha' rlung rngub bzhin 'cham 'cham du 'gro rgyur mos pa che/ lhag par du lo gcig dus bzhi'i chab zhugs dus chen gyi skabs khel stabs sa mtho'i dwangs gtsang chu bo rnams kyi 'khris su mi tshogs ha cang mang / de nyin chab zhugs dus chen gyi nyin gsum pa yin zhing / nam mkha' sngo zhing dwangs la sprin dkar gyi tshom bu re tsam dal gyis rgyu zhing / nyi 'od rab tu gsal ba dang ston rlung 'jam po zhig bsil bsil ldang yong ba bcas sa mtho'i nyi 'od grong gi gnam gshis tsha grang snyoms la mkha' rlung gtsang ba'i dus tshigs legs shos su bslebs pa'i tshor snang zhig lhang nger mngon/nyin gung chu tshod2pa tsam la nyang bran lung mdo'i 'bab chu'i rgyug khul du 'byor byung / dwangs bsil ngang rgyu ba'i nyang bran 'bab chu'i g.yas g.yon du ar 'dam dang rdo yis rtsig pa mthon por brtsigs pa dang / gsham nas gar 'dam nar mos 'phred bcad btang ste chu rkyal rgyag yul gyi rdzing bu yid du 'ong ba zhig bskrun 'dug la/ chu rdzing gi 'gram ngogs dag na grong mi rnams blo bde bag phebs kyi sgo nas khrus la rol ba ni 'dab ldan chu bya sna 58
smyug rtse'i bzhur rgyun/tshogs 'phur lding rkyal gsum gyi dpal la rol ba dang shin tu 'dra la/ lo na bgres pa'i grong mi rnams sku gzugs chu la dal bur zhugs rjes sngo ljang ljon pa'i grib bsil legs la ne'u gsing gos chen ljang gu btings pa 'dra ba'i chu 'gram dag tu phan tshun snga rgyus da rgyus gleng bzhin tsha dam nang du khur ba'i gsol ja bsrubs ma longs su spyod bzhin mchis/lo na phra ba'i gzhon skyes mang po zhig ra skor gyi steng nas the tshom spu tsam med par rdzing bu'i nang du mchong skabs chu rdzing gi rba rlabs dgung du 'phyo bar byed pa ni/ gser mig can la rngam pa'i chu skyar zhig dang 'dra la/ de mur lag gnyis kyi 'gul skyod la brten nas rdzing bu'i rlabs ris rkyal gyis gcod skabs 'dab gshog 'dzoms pa'i ngang pa dkar po zhig gis mtsho mo'i rba rlabs pha mthar gcod pa'i ngang tshul blo la 'khor bar byed/ yang lus smad chu la zhugs nas mgo bo chu khar dgye ste ngal gsos nas 'dug skabs chu gnas lcong mo zhig gi tshugs ka 'dra ba'i thog nas 'jig rten 'phel 'gyur smra ba'i mkhas pa 'ga' yis/ mi'i rigs 'di chu gnas srog chags las byung bar bshad pa'i chod don de yang bden pa red gang snyam pa'i blo re skye nges yin/las la brtson pa'i lha sa'i bud med rnams kyis khyim gyi kha ga dan dang /mal gzan btsugs phrug sogs gyon gos sna tshogs bcal du bkram nas la la chur bkrus zin nas skam du btang ba dang / la la 'khrud bzhin pa/ 'ga' re bkru rgyur bzhag pa bcas khra chil chil du mngon par lta yag ma byas na chu 59
byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/'gram du tshong zog sna tshogs bton nas bsdad 'dug snyam pa'i tshor snang zhig sbyin srid/ de ltar rgan dar gzhon gsum med par chab zhugs dus chen dga' gtong byed pa'i rnam pa dag las lha sa pa rnams lhod lhod ngang bag yangs kyi 'tsho bar rol ba'i rnam pa zhig mngon bzhin 'dug la/ kho tsho'i lus bde sems skyid kyi 'tsho ba gsar pa'i bde skyid dag kyang zur sna tshogs nas mngon bzhin mchis/'on kyang / kho tshos dus chen dga' gtong la rol ba'i shul gang sar mngar cha'i skogs pa dang / 'gyig shog sna tshogs bdag med du bskyur pa la 'ga' res rlung gi rgyu phyogs dang bstun nas shu glu sgrog pa dang / 'ga' zhig bdag po dang bral bas nga tshos rang snang gang shar byed chog zer ba ltar sngo ljang ljon shing gi yal gar 'khyud 'gro ba dang / 'ga' re dwangs bsil bsil ngang rgyu ba'i 'bab chu'i nang du 'dzul 'gro zhing / mang po zhig ne'u gsing g.yu gzhong 'dra ba 'ga' yi zur na phung gsog thebs pa'i tshul gyis mnyam du 'tshogs pa ni 'byung khams sbag btsog ji ltar gtong lugs thad la gros kha sdur ba dang shin tu 'dra/ de dang mnyam du shog bu'i lag phyis 'ga' yang kho tsho dang mnyam du bag med rang dgar 'khyam bzhin 'dug la/ de dag gis gdug can gyi nad 'bu gang 'dra zhig 'khur yod min su yis rtogs/2009 960
smyug rtse'i bzhur rgyun/tshad ma'i chu mgogna' snga mor dal gyis 'bab pa'i skyid chu sngon mo'i g.yas g.yon nas shes rig gi sgron me sbar zhing / lta ngan gyi mun pa bsal ba'i rig gzhung gi lo rgyus ni yar chab gtsang po'i bzhur sgra de las skad che zhing / gangs mthon mthing rgyal mo'i mtho tshad de las dpang mtho ba yod la/ gnas 'di nas dar ba'i shes rig gi sgron me ni nang chos rig pa dang / lta ngan gyi mun pa sel mkhan ni thal ngag gi ral gri rnon po de lags/ de ni mes po tsho'i mi tshe'i rin thang gi lta ba ngom sa dang / mi yul nas bzhag pa'i rngam brjid kyi gtam rgyud gcig pu de yin pas tshad ma'i chu mgo ni mes po tsho'i ngo mtshar gyi gtam rgyud de'i mgo brtsams sa ngo ma de los yin/ tshad ma'i chu mgo 'tshol ba ni mes po'i dam bca' dang / 'gyur med kyi lta ba brtan po de 'tshol ba yin la/mes po'i kha lag gnyis la goms pa'i thal ngag gi phyag rgya btsan po de red/61
dang po/dngos po rnams chos can/ rang bzhin gyis ma grub ste/ rten 'brel yin pa'i phyir/ de ni mes po tshos btod pa'i gtan tshigs kyi dam bca' zhig yin la/kha ba can gyi dgon sde khag tu brag cha bzhin rna bar 'jags nas yod/ da cha nga tshos gtan tshigs dum bu der phyir 'dang zhig gis dran gsos byed skabs/ 'das zin pa'i dus rabs su mi rigs shig gi shes rig gi 'od snang mig lam du mngon srid la/ phyir dran khri 'bum gyis brtsegs pa'i 'das song gi dur byang mang po mig lam du shar yong / dam bca' de ni nga tsho'i mi rabs kyi sha gseng rus su thim pa'i dngos po'i chos nyid la 'dzin pa'i 'gyur med kyi dam bca' yin la/ lung rigs stong gis gzhom zhig mi nus pa'i 'khrul med kyi gtan tshigs shig yin par brjod kyang thal che yod rgyu ma red/gtan tshigs de gna' snga mo nas kha ba can gyi mkhas pa tsho'i thugs la legs par nges shing / ngag la yongs su byang ba zhig yin mod kyang / 'dzam gling khyon du dus rabs bco brgyad dang bcu dgu'i nang la gzhi nas rnyed par gleng /mi rigs shig gi phyi rabs pa yin pa'i nga tsho'i ngos nas bshad na/ yun ring gi lo rgyus nang / gtan tshigs rig pa'i gzhung lugs de gnas gang nas byung zhing / sa cha gang du thog mar dar ba/ skyes bu sus kha skong dang 'thus 62
smyug rtse'i bzhur rgyun/tshang du btang ba bcas kyi thad la rgyus lon yang dag byed rgyu ni pha mes kyi shul bzhag la bdag gces byed pa'i bya ba gal chen zhig yin mod/ ri tshogs dang / lung shur mang ba'i kha ba can der lo rgyus dag ri tshogs stug po dang /lung shur mang po de'i khrod nas yal bzhin yod la/ tha na 'ga' zhig sa cha mi 'dra ba gnyis re dang gsum re ru ngos 'dzin byas pa mang du mngon/ kha ba can gyi tshad ma'i chu mgo de yang skye bo phal che ba'i blo ngo nas yal la nye zhing /ci med tshor med du skyur bzhin mchis/rgyang ring nas bltas tshe lha ldan zhing ni ri tshogs kyi yol bas bskor zhing / skyid chu sngon mo ni mu tig gi phreng ba sa la bsnar ba dang 'dra/ kha ba can gyi shes rig gi rgyun thag dang / lo rgyus kyi rlabs ris bkra ba'i skyid chu sngon mo'i 'bab rgyud ni gangs can ljongs kyi tshad ma'i mgo khungs dang tshad ma'i pha sa pha yul yin zhes brjod kyang mi chog pa med/ 'on kyang / skyid chu'i 'bab rgyud kyi sa cha gang zhig tshad ma'i mgo khungs dngos yin pa de da lta'i char skyes bu phal che bas do snang yod mi srid/gnyis pa/dal gyis 'bab pa'i skyid chu sngon mo'i shar ngos kyi ri tshogs stug po'i gseb nas kyag kyog tu chags pa'i lung shur de dag re re ni yab mes kyi rkang rjes phab sa dang rnam shes thim sa 'khrul med dag yin pas/ gnas de 63
byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/dag nas kho tsho'i dga' skyo chags sdang gi 'du long rgyas myong la/ dga' sdang zhen bral gyi ting 'dzin klong du yang bzhugs myong stabs lung shur de dag ni bam mthug pa'i lo rgyus kyi glegs bam zhig dang 'dra bar ma zad/ gsang ba yang gsang du gnas pa'i 'tshe med zhi ba'i dga' tshal gcig pu de'ang yin/lung shur de dag gi khrod nas g.yas g.yon gyi ri bo mtho zhing / klung la grog rong gis khongs pa'i lung pa de ni bod kyi gtan tshigs rig pa'i ral gri thog mar brdungs sa red/da lta'i lha sa grong khyer tshal sna yul tsho'i gsang phu grong tsho'i phur gnas pa'i gsang phu ne'u thog dgon pa ni rgya gar nas phebs pa'i jo bo a ti shas/skyid chu'i yar kha nas gnas der phyag mdzub ker te/ ngas mthong snang la lung pa pha gi'i nang la rngog legs pa'i shes rab nas mgo skya ye re chos 'chad pa'i nyams snang byung tshul gsungs pa dang / rngog nas re zhig gsang ba gnang bar zhu zhus pas gsang phu zhes pa'i ming de thogs par grags/ re zhig gsang ba mdzad pa'i gsang gnas de rngog lo tsā legs pa'i shes rab kyis rab byung dang po'i chu glang ste spyi lo1073lor thog mar phyag btab pa dang / thog mar 'dus pa lnga brgya'i skor la rngog los 'chad nyan bskyangs myong zhing / rjes su lha sa stag rtse khul gyi phywa zhes pa'i sa char 'khrungs pa'i phywa ba chos kyi seng ges mkhan thog drug pa'i gdan 'dzin lo bco brgyad gnang nas bod rang gi thun min khyad chos ldan pa'i tshad ma rig pa'i rig lam rtsod stangs gsar btod gnang / khong gis seng chen brgyad ces pa'i slob ma grags chen 'ga' 64
smyug rtse'i bzhur rgyun/zhig gso skyong gnang ba dang / lhag par gzhung bka' pod lnga la slob gnyer byed pa'i lam srol btsugs te/ 'dzin grwa'i rim pa dbye ba dang / 'dzin grwa 'phar rim bzhin mtshan thob sna tshogs sprod pa/ 'dzin grwa rtsod pa byed pa/rtsod gleng byed pa'i go rim dang / thabs shes sna tshogs gsar gtod mdzad de bod rang gi thun min khyad chos ldan pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i gzhung lugs sbyong stangs shig chags par byas yod/ khong gi tshad ma rig pa'i rtsod gleng gnang stangs de bod kyi gdan sa khag dang / chos lugs grub mtha' khag kun la dar khyab byung yod pas khong la bod kyi tshad ma'i srol btod slob dpon gyi mtshan snyan gsol yang 'gal ba med la/ gsang phu dgon pa ni de bas bod kyi tshad ma'i chu mgo yin par gleng na 'os shing 'tsham/yongs su grags pa'i bod kyi tshad ma'i chu mgo'i gdan sa der ches dar ba'i skabs su gling stod gling smad gnyis la grwa tshang bcu ga cig yod pa dang / se 'bras dga' gsum ma byung gong gi dbus kyi gdan sa chen po drug gi ya gyal zhig yin pas/ dus skabs shig gi ring rje tsong kha ba sogs bod kyi mkhas pa'i dbang po mang dag cig gdan sa der slob gnyer mdzad nas mkhas par chags pa'am/ grwa sa 'dir rtsod gleng gnang ba brgyud mkhas grags thob pa sha stag yin/ 'on kyang / dus kyi 'pho 'gyur sna tshogs khrod gsang phu de yang rgyud 'dzin pa'i skyes bu du ma byon pa'i nang nas dar rgud sna tshogs nyams su myong dgos byung ste/ grwa tshang bcu gcig po de dag sa phyogs gang sar thor ba dang / gtan bzhugs dge 'dun gyi sde yang rim 65
byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/bzhin je nyung du song ste da lta'i dus 'dir skyes bu phal mo ches do snang byed mkhan med pa'i ming don mtshungs pa'i gsang phu zhig tu 'gyur la nye/gsum pa/bod t+yā tshad ma'i mkhas pa zhig gis ngag las/pha rol thal bas sun 'byin ral gri'i char/ /rang gi zhe 'dod sgrub ngag bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /rtags las rjes dpag rtog bral mngon sum gyi/ /dgag gzhag phra zhib tshad ma'i rigs lam gtsang / /zhes pa'i bstod tshig bsgrags myong bar ma zad/ rgyal khab phyi nang gi mkhas pa mang pos bstod dbyangs 'then myong ba'i bod kyi tshad ma'i rigs lam ni/ pha rol pos rgol du 'ong ba la ya lan sprod par ci 'dra'i rno ngar ldan zhing / rig pa brdar sha gcod par ci 'dra'i phra zhib ldan pa zhig red gang /thal ngag gi 'gyur khugs re res log rtog gi lta ba rdul du bslag la bag mi tsha zhing / mngon rjes rig pas dpag pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyi klong nas ma rtog log rtog the tshom gyi dogs pa'i seng ras ma lus dum bur gtong la rno dbal shin tu bzang ba dang / dngos po'i chos nyid la phra zhib blo yis dpyod par rig pa 'di las lhag cig gang na'ang ma mchis pa 'dra/ yin na 'ang / yod tshad chos nyid stong pa'i rgyal sar bzhugs pa'i bod snga rabs kyi rig pa'i dpa' bo 66
smyug rtse'i bzhur rgyun/tshos/ rig pa'i sgo 'byed bzang po 'di nang bstan gyi gzhung lugs kho na'i slob gnyer sgo 'byed cig dang / nang bstan gzhung gi rgya bod bstan bcos gsed 'grol gyi rgyu cha kho na las spyi tshogs khyon la phan pa'i lam du 'dren ma thub cing / tha na phra zhib kyi rigs lam der bskyod mkhan tshos sngar gyi lam kha gcig pu de rgya bskyed tsam las/ sngar med kyi lam bu sna tshogs la 'tshol snyeg byed sems yid la ma 'khor ba ni ci 'dra'i skyo gar zhig red ya/de bas yid skyo ba zhig la/ phywa ba chos kyi seng ges srol btod pa nas de ring gi dus rabs bar du tshad ma rig pa zhes pa de bod kyi spyi tshogs khyon yongs la ming tsam go myong ba las/ rig pa der slob gnyer byed pa'i lam srol zhig dar khyab ma byung zhing / dgon sde'i ser mo ba dang / sku drag re zung gi mkhar sgo las 'grol ma thub stabs/ 'jig rten sher rtog rig pa'i gzhung lugs de yang don du bod mi phal ba'i blo ngor ga sang ba yang gsang du gyur/kho tshos mi chos rig gnas kyi khongs su gtogs pa'i mi'i rigs kyi 'tsho tshis skyong phyogs dang / 'tsho gnas yar rgyas/ rang byung khams kyi gsang ba shes rtogs byed rgyu sogs kyi thad la 'dren sbyor dang bkol spyod rtsa ba nas ma thub pas/ bod kyi 'phel rgyas lam bur rig gnas des zhabs 'degs zhu ma thub cing / nam yang gser 'od 'phro ba'i gtsug lag khang gi zhabs nas lta ba stong nyid du gtan la 'bebs pa'i thal ngag nyag gcig tu gyur pas/ spyi tshogs kyi nag nyes ther 'don ma thub cing / mi'i rigs kyi mdun lam rgyang ring du bsring ba'i thad byas rjes 'jog ma thub/67

byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/ba dkar po'i bar du 'brel yod par grags la/ thang lha rang gi ri rgyud dngos la mtshon na'ang gangs ri'i phreng ba kho nas 'dam gzhung lung gi rgyab ri yongs su rdzogs pa dang 'brel nas yod/ gangs ri'i phreng ba mdzes shing lta na sdug pa de dag gi dbus su gnyan chen thang lha de nyid rgyal po khri la bzhugs pa lta bu'i brjid nyams kyis phyug cing nub byang gnam mtsho'i phyug mo'i phyogs su mdun bstan nas 'gying nger gnas yod la/ g.yas g.yon du thang sras 'phyor bo dang / khung khyim zhal dkar/ mgul ring phrag thag sogs ’blon po'i tshul du 'khor gyis bskor nas gnas yod tshul gyi ri bshad dang /dmangs khrod shod srol sna tshogs pa yod/gangs ri chen po gnyan chen thang lha ni bod brgyud nang bstan chos lugs kyi srung ma zhig yin pas grub mtha' khag gi bla ma tshos mdzad pa'i bsang dang gsol mchod mang po yod cing / de dag nang khong ni sa brgyad thob pa'i sems dpa' dang / byang sems nam mkha'i snying po'i sprul pa/ dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa zhes pa de yin tshul dang / lha yi dbang po brgya byin nad kyis mnar ba'i skabs dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa ste da lta'i gnyan chen thang lhas bcom ldan 'das la lha dbang nad las grol ba'i skyabs 'jug zhus don bzhin lha dbang nad las grol ba'i bya dgar dbang po rang gi sras mo gnam mtsho phyug mo bya dga'i tshul du sbyin tshul sogs lha sgrung mang po yod la/ da dung gnyan chen po thang lhar sras dang / gcung po/chen ma/ chung ma/ phyi blon/ nang blon/ bar blon/ lug rdzi/ nor rdzi/ khyi rdzi/ ra rdzi 82
smug rtse'i bzhur rgyun/sogs 'jig rten mi yul gyi 'brog pa'i sde dpon zhig la mnga' ba'i blon 'bangs 'khor g.yog dang yongs su mtshungs pa yod tshul yang 'khod yod stabs dmangs khrod ngag rgyun du de'i skor yongs khyab tu shod srol yod/gzhan yang srid pa'i lha chen 'od de gung rgyal dang / yum g.yu bya gshog gcig bya ba gnyis la sras sras mo mang du byung ba'i gras shig yin pa'i gtam rgyud kyang yod cing / gang ltar gangs ri chen po 'di ni ngo mtshar ba'i lha sgrung dang shod srol du mas yongs su phyug pa ni gna' mi rgan po zhig dang cis mi 'dra/ der ma zad/ bod kyi srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu dang / rje yi mgul lha bcu gsum gyi gras su gtogs pa dang / grub mtha' ris med kyis mchod bstod byed pa'i lha ri grags chen zhig kyang yin/ de ltar gtam rgyud dang lha sgrung du mas mdzes pa'i ri bo de nyid don dngos su byas rjes kyis phyug pa'i nga tsho'i mes po gong ma 'brog pa'i gras su gtogs pa zhig tshe las 'das rjes lha ru 'phos pa'i 'du shes dang / gangs ri chen po der gnas bcas yod par snyam pa'i dad sems kyi 'du shes las mchod bstod bsang gsol byed pa'i lam srol byung ba la/ mi'i rigs kyi bsam blo'i lta tshul dang chos lugs kyi dad mos 'du shes la 'gyur ba sna tshogs brgyud pa'i lo rgyus kyi chu rgyun ring mo'i nang shod rgyun dang / lha sgrung sna tshogs sa khyab rdo khyab tu byung ba kho nar nges la/ des nga tshos mi'i rigs kyi dad mos 'du shes dang / sems jikhams kyi 'gyur bar phyir rtog byed rgyur phan pa 'thob nges par ma zad/ rang byung khams dang mi'i rigs bar gyi gsang ba sna tshogs la yang bsam gzhig 83
byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/gi sgo mo 'byed rgyur phan nges so/ /gnam sngon mo sa la babs 'dra'i gnam mtsho phyug mo/gnyan chen thang lha'i lcam du grags pa'i gnam mtsho phyug mo ni srid pa'i gangs ri gnyan chen thang lha'i byang mdun du gnam sngon sa la 'phos pa ltar sngo ltems mer dang / ljang mer rer 'khyil nas yod cing / mu mtha' med pa'i rtswa thang dang / bgrang las 'das pa'i phyug rigs dkar nag gi khyu tshogs/bag yangs su rgyu ba'i ri dwags sogs kyis gnam mtsho'i mdzes sdug la de bas kha snon brgyab pa dang 'dra/ mtsho de'i rgya khyon gyi cha shas mang che ba nag chu'i dpal mgon rdzong khongs yin yang yul skor sgo 'byed byas zin pa'i khul dag ni 'dam gzhung rdzong khongs su gtogs pa yin/gnam mtsho phyug mo ni rgya khyon spyi le gru bzhi ma1900tsam yod pa dang /mtsho dbyibs rdo rje phag mo gan rkyal gyi dbyibs su grub yod pa ste/ nub kyi lha lcam mkhan pa ri ni dbu rgyan gyi tshul du gnas pa dang / ngang chu dang drel chu gnyis mnyam du 'dres pa'i chu lag de phyag g.yas su bsnams pa'i gri gug gi tshul du gnas pa/ nub byang ngos kyi srin mo do ni phyag g.yon bskums pa'i tshul du gnas pa'i gru khug yin pa/ lho shar phyogs kyi bkra shis do ni zhabs g.yas bskums pa'i khugs de yin par dang / sgo ra ha bo'i do ni zhabs g.yon brkyangs pa'i zhabs kyi ro gdan gyi tshul du yod par grags la/ gnas 84
smyug rtse'i bzhur rgyun/mtsho de nyid bod kyi nang 'bab mtsho mo che shos de yin par ma zad/ gnas mtsho'i lo rgyus dang / dwangs la gtsang ba'i mtsho mo'i kha zheng / chil chil rlabs gnyer g.yo ba'i sgeg nyams bcas kyis phyogs bzhi'i yul skor sku mgron tsho'i yid kyi brtan pa dbang med du 'phrog par byed kyi yod/ gnam mtsho phyug mo ni slob dpon pad mas phyag rjes bzhag par grags pa'i mtsho chen bzhi yi ya gyal zhig dang / bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan rdo rje kun grags ma'i pho brang / mtsho dbyibs rgyal yum rdo rje phag mo'i sku dbyibs su grub pa/ phyogs bzhir nad gdon sdig sgrib 'dag pa'i khrus sgo rnam bzhi lhun chags su gnas pa/ mtsho dkyil du brjid chags yid du 'ong ba'i gling phran du ma bcas kyis phyi'i rang byung khams kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i mdzes sdug dang / nang gsang ba lkog gyur lha sgrung snyan mo mang pos phyug pa/ khyad par chos lugs dad mos kyis gnas mtsho khyad 'phags su sngon byon chos lugs kyi skyes chen mang pos lung bstan pa dang / byin brlabs pa'i lo rgyus sogs thun mong min pa'i khyad chos de dag bod ljongs tsam ma zad/ mes rgyal nang khongs dang tha na rgyal spyir skad grags kyis khyab nas yod/da dung bra'u dngos ngan gyis gnam mtsho phyug mo dang gnyan chen thang lha'i rgyud du bzhag pa'i ya mtshan can gyi gna' gtam dang / gnam mtsho brgya sbyin gyi sras mo yin pa'i lha sgrung sogs ni ngo mtshar 'bum gyis phyug pa'i deng rabs kyi glog brnyan gang gis kyang 'gran du mi nus pa'i rna bar snyan 'jibs kyi dga' ston dang yid la the tshom gyi 'dri tshig du ma bskyed pa'i ngo 85
byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/mtshar gyi gtam rgyud sha stag yin/gnam mtsho phyug mo'i nang du nub nas ngang chu drel chu dang / shar nas nya chu gtsang po sogs chu bo dang chu phran du ma 'bab bzhin yod rung mtsho mo de las yul gru gzhan du dwangs bsil gyi chab rgyun rta rnga tsam yang mi 'bab stabs nang 'bab kyi mtsho mo zhes yongs su grags/ 'on kyang / nye dus kyi rtsom yig 'gar lha sa'i skyid chu la byang gi gnam mtsho phyug mo dang / gnyan chen thang lha gnyis nas 'bab pa'i chu bo 'dres yod tshul brjod mkhan yod par ma zad/ tha na la las skyid chu'i chu mgo de byang gi gnam mtsho phyug mo yin par bris pa'ang 'dug mod/ de ni sa cha dngos la rtog zhib legs po ma byung ba'i skyon du zad de gnam mtsho phyug mo nas skyid chur chu thigs gcig kyang 'bab kyin med pa sa cha dngos la rgyus lon byas na gsal por rtogs nges yin/yin na'ang / gangs ri chen po gnyan chen thang lha'i rgyab ngos te 'dam gzhung phyogs kyi gangs ri'i khong gseng nas 'bab pa'i g.ya' chu rnams gcig tu 'dres pa'i 'dam chu sngon mo de ra sgreng khul gyi phod mdo brgyud 'bri gung khul nas 'bab pa'i gzhu rong gtsang chu dang 'dres nas skyid chu sngon mo'i dpa' nyams rgyas byed dang lang tsho'i skyor ma byed bzhin yod pa'ang shes dgos nges lags/gnas mtsho grags chen gnam mtsho phyug mo'i snyan pa phyogs mthar bsgrags mkhan gyi pho nya lte bu'i gnam mtsho bkra shis gling phran nam/ bkra shis do ni brnyan 'phrin mtho lcog lta bu'i brag rdo kher gcig dang / gdod ma'i 86
smyug rtse'i bzhur rgyun/gzugs ris yi ge yod pa'i rang byung brag phug kha ba ri ba'i sngon byon skyes chen dam pa'i sgrub phug kha dog rnam par bkra ba'i dar rdang / mtho tshad nam mkhar bsnyegs pa'i brag ri'i phung po sogs mtshar sdug yid du 'ong ba'i rang byung khams kyi mdzes pa rmad du byung la/ da dung nam mkha' sngo zhing dwangs pa'i skabs su lho nub phyogs nas rgyal po khri la 'khod 'dra'i gnyan chen thang lha brjid nyams kyis 'gying zhing / gangs ri'i mdzes sdug mtsho mo'i ngogs su gsal ba dang / snga dgong nyi 'od phog phyogs 'ga' la gangs ri gser dwangs rnam par bkra bar de bas yid dbang 'phrog shugs che/ nub dang byang gi phyogs nas chal chil rba rlabs sgrog pa'i gnam mtsho phyug mo dgung sngon thang la 'phos pa ltar rgya khyon shin tu che bas gnam dang mtsho gnyis gzhi gcig tu 'dres par gnam sa'i gru kha gzhan zhig tu bslebs pa lta bu'i tshor snang sbyin srid/mdzes sdug yid du 'ong ba'i gling phran de ni lha tshogs bdun stong nyis brgya'i bzhugs gnas yin par ma zad/ gnam mtsho'i phyogs bzhi'i zhi rgyas dbang drag gi khrus sgo bzhi'i nang gi shar gyi zhi ba'i khrus sgo'ang gnas mchog der yin zhing / gnas kyi rang byon bkod pa yid du 'ong la/ skyes bu dam pa'i phyag rjes dang zhabs rjes dang / byin rlabs mtshams sgrub gnang myong ba'i phug pa sogs shin tu mang bas dad ldan mjal ba rnams kyi dad gus kyi mchi ma dbang med 'khrigs par byed cing / phyogs med yul skor ba rnams rang byung khams kyi ngo mtshar bkod pa dang / dpog dka' ba'i lha sgrung 'byung tshul/87
byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/gting zab pa'i bod brgyud nang bstan gyi gnas mchog yin tshul sogs kyis yid dbang yongs su 'gug par byed kyi yod/rjo brkos sku brnyan gyi pha gzhis khang dmar dgon pa/rdo la sku brnyan bzhengs pa'i sgyu rtsal ni bod la ches snga dus nas dar yod pas bsam yas dgon dang / khra 'brug dgon pa sogs su de snga rdo la lder bzo byas pa'i rnam par snang mdzad sogs kyi sku brnyan bzo rtsal phul du byung ba yod par ma zad/ zur mkhar rdo yi mchod rten dang / snye mo'i 'gro ba mchod rten sogs rdo la lder bzo byas pa'i mchod rten rigs kyang 'ga' re yod pa red/ lder bzo ste rdo la 'bur gzugs rbad de byas pa'i rigs min pa'i phyed 'bur gzugs can gyi sku brnyan rigs ni de bas bod kyi yul gru gang sar sa khyab rdo khyab tu dar yod pa dang / de dag gi nang nas dpe mtshon du 'dren 'os pa lcags po ri'i gsham gyi mi 'khrug pa dang / snye thang gi lha chen po sogs mang du yod/ de dag so sor lo rgyus ngos nas dbye zhib byas na dus rabs mi 'dra bar so sor dmigs bsal gyi bzo rgyun dang / sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos chen po ldan yod pa ni bshad ma dgos mod/ brag ri'i ngos su bzhengs pa'i sku brnyan chen po de dag las rdo leb phal ba'i ngos su brkos pa'i rigs dang / rdo la lder bzo byas pa'i sku brnyan phal mo che rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs su thal ba'i rdul du gyur te da lta rang cag tsho'i mig gi longs spyod du 88

byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/nag nog cung zad phog pa dang / rdo brkos kyi sku brnyan gcig kho na rgyu mtshan ji ltar yin pa ma shes kyang gar song cha med du song 'dug pa las de byings nyams chag cung zad tsam yang ma shor bar gnas thub ste da lta'i dus su rang cag tsho'i mig gi longs spyod dang / rin thang bral ba'i rdo brkos sgyu rtsal gyi zhing khams shig tu gyur pa ni ci 'dra'i dga' 'os pa zhig red ang /da lta dgon pa de ljongs rim pa'i rig dngos srung skyob sde tshan gyi khongs su tshud de nyams gso'i mgo brtsams dang rtsom bzhin 'dug la/ sngon gyi rdo brkos de dag la phyogs bzhi'i skyes bu'i blo yid 'gug shugs nyin bzhin che ru dang do snang nyin bzhin che ru 'gro bzhin 'dugnod sel bdud rtsi'i khrus jing thang lha'i chu tshan/mi zhig la mtshon na nad med bde thang du gnas 'dod pa ni ches gal che'i dmigs yul zhig dang / mi yul du 'tsho ba'i ring gi bde skyid mthar thug de yang yin/ go la hril por dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i 'gran rtsod nyin bzhin dza drag tu 'gro ba dang / mi'i rigs kyi dpal 'byor dgos mkhor bsten pa'i tshad gzhi rim bzhin mtho ru 'gro ba dang sbrags dpal 'byor la 'dod rngam gyi me lce de yang shugs drag je cher 'gro bzhin yod pas/bde thang gi dga' skyid longs su spyod pa'i sman bcos 'phrod bsten thad la'ang snga na med pa'i sgor mo'i 'gro gron gtong dgos par ma zad/ sgor mo 90

byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/lcags zam lung du bskyod pa'i 'char snang /drag tu rgyug pa'i chu bos mi'i rigs kyi shar nub lho byang gi 'grim 'grul rgyu lam bkag myong bas/ tshong las dang / shes rigachos lugs sogs brgyud spel dang / 'brel 'dris byed rgyu'i thad la bkag rdo sna tshogs shig sprad myong yod stabs/ mi'i rigs byung ba nas bzung mi rigs mi gcig pa dang yul lung mi 'dra ba so sos bkag rgya de las thar ba'i ched du ko gru dang / gru chen/ 'breng shud lta bus mtshon pa'i chu bo'i rgyu lam 'phyed du gcod pa'i blo gros sna tshogs shig spel myong yod cing / rim bzhin shes rig gi blo gros dang /lag rtsal gi chu tshad je legs su phyin te deng rabs can gyi phyogs su bskyod thub pa byung yod/dang po/lcags thag gi zam pa bskrun pa ni blo gros dang lag rtsal gnyis thad 106
smyug rtse'i bzhur rgyun/nas bar brgal chen po byung ba'i chu thog 'grim 'grul gyi stabs bde'i dgos mkho gal chen zhig yin par ma zad/ mi'i rigs 'di rang byung khams las rnam par rgyal ba'i mdun skyod kyi lam tshad rdo ring zhig yin pa'ang smos ci dgos/ bod 'dir lcags zam gsar skrun byed mkhan de grub chen thang stong rgyal po yin pa'i 'dod tshul zhig sa khyab rdo khyab tu gyur yod stabs mi gzhan gyis de min pa'i lung dang rigs pa gnyis thad nas sgrub byed gsal por bton na'ang yid ches byed dka' mod/ don dngos thog bod 'dir ches snga dus nas rgyal rong khul du lcags thag gi zam pa bskrun pa'i shod rgyun yod skad 'dug la/ spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i nang tsam la marma sku phreng gsum pa rang byung rdo rjes da lta'i nag chu'i sog rdzong khul du lcags zam bskrun pa'i lo rgyus yod par ma zad/ zam shul yang lus yod skad 'dug pas nyung mthar yang grub chen thang stong rgyal po ma 'khrungs gong gi lo lnga bcu'i gong du lcags zam rgyag pa'i lag rtsal gyi rgyun srol yod pa shes thub/ 'on kyang bod kyi sa cha'i stod smad yul gru kun tu chu bo che chung bgrang med cig la lcags zam skrun mkhan ni grub chen thang stong rgyal po yin pa don dngos lags/yin na'ang / da lta'i dus la lcags zam skrun mkhan thog ma su yin dang /dus rabs gang la byung ba shes rtogs byed rgyu las kyang gal che ba ni lcags zam lta bu'i shes rig nang 'dren gyi lam bu gang mang btings te/ nga tshos ma mthong ba'i phyi rol yul gyi mdzes pa dang mtshar sdug gang mang sdud len byas 107
byang thang na bzhur rgyun/nas go rtogs sad pa'i 'du shes gsar pa dang / bsam blo gsar pa zhig gi gzhi tshugs thub par byed pa dgos pa de yin par snang /gnyis pa/bod kyi lo rgyus thog gi chos lugs pa dang / bzo rig pa/ gso ba rig pa/sgyu rtsal rig pa bcas mkhas can yin pa'i grub chen thang stong rgyal pos thog mar lha sa'i skyid chu'i lha gdong shan khar lcags zam bskrun pa nas bzung lcags zam lnga bcu rtsa brgyad dang / shing zam drug cu/ gru shan chen mo'i rigs brgya dang bco brgyad bcas gsar bskrun gnang yod par grags mod/ mi lo bdun brgyar nye ba'i nang la zam pa phal mo che da lta'i char mig gi mthong yul du mngon dka' bar gyur na'ang / gzhis rtse rnam gling rdzong du lcags zam de'i rigs 'ga' zhig da dung ma nyams par gnas 'dug de las rnam gling grong rdal rang gi dkyil du yod pa'i shangs chu zam chen ni sngar dus su zam pa grags chen zhig yin khar/ deng dus rdzong grong rdal gnas yul du yod stabs rig dngos srung skyob sde tshan du tshud pa dang / sa gnas de ga'i rim khag srid gzhung nas srung skyob dang nyams gso'i thabs lam sna tshogs bton dang 'don mus yin la/ phyogs bzhi'i yul skor ba phal mo che'i rna lam du thos yod mod/ rnam gling rdzong gi zab phu lung pa'i nang du lcags zam de'i rigs gnyis gsum zhig 'dug kyang da lta 'di yin med par nyams rgud du 108
smyug rtse'i bzhur rgyun/'gro bzhin lus 'dugde yang grub chen thang stong rgyal pos bskrun pa'i zam pa la grub chen rang nyid nas thad kur jus 'don sne khrid gnang ste bzhengs pa'i zam pa dang / lcags thag 'then pa'i dus sogs 'gag rtsa'i dus skabs 'ga' la grub chen rang nyid nas gzigs rtog dang jus 'god gnang ba las bu slob tshos bskrun pa'i zam pa/ bu slob rnams sa phyogs so sor mngags rdzong gis bu slob rnams kyis jus 'don sne khrid byas nas bskrun pa'i zam pa bcas rigs gsum yod skad 'dug la/ da dung khong gi phyag rgyun ltar bskrun pa'i zam pa'ang yod srid phyir/ shangs zab phu lung du bskrun pa'i zam pa de dag gang gi khongs su gtogs min ma shes kyang / grub chen thang stong mchog gis khyab spel btang ba'i snga rabs bod kyi lcags zam bskrun pa'i phyag rgyun phul du byung ba de la brten nas bskrun pa zhig yin pa ni 'dzugs skrun gyi rnam pa gang thad nas gsal por mngon gyi 'dug gzhis rtse'i rnam gling rdzong la shangs rnam gling khul zhes sngar nas brjod kyang kho bos 'dir lcags zam lung pa zhes 'dogs don ni grub chen thang stong rgyal pos bskrun pa'am/ khong gi phyag rgyun bzhin bzhengs pa'i sngar dus kyi lcags zam 'ga' zhig lhag yod pas skye bo tshang mas thun mong ma yin pa'i bod kyi lcags zam bskrun dngos de las sa cha de dag la do snang gsar pa zhig 'byung rgyur dmigs pa yin/lha chos rig gnas de bod kyi gtso rgyug rig gnas su chags nas skyes 109
byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/bu tshang ma der mos pa dang dad zhen gyi rba rlabs nyin bzhin 'phyur ba'i dus 'dir/ lha chos rig gnas la sbyang brtson gnang nas mkhas par gyur pa'i skyes mchog des zam pa bskrun pa dang / zlos gar gyi 'khrab gzhung gsar gtod gnang ba/ lcags rigs bzhu btul gyi phyag las bskyangs pa lta bus mtshon mi chos rig gnas sna tshogs dar spel gnang ba ni ci 'dra'i dkyel yangs can dang / mig rgyang can zhig red ang / gsum pa/chu bo'i lho byang 'phyed du bcad pa'i lcags nag 'gug ma dang / rdo brtsegs kyi zam sgo mthon po de dag rig dus mi rigs shig gi sngar dus kyi las brtson snying stobs dang / blo gros kyi 'khor rgya la ha las byung mod/ mi lo bdun brgyar nye ba'i dus rabs nang mi rigs 'dis 'dzugs skrun lam srol la de las lhag pa'i cithod brgal byung med par ma zad/ tha na de snga'i lag rtsal bzang po cinyams par gyur par mthong dus sems pa blong blong bor gyur song /kho bo bsam gzhig gi klong du tshud pa'i skabs der rnying zad du gyur pa'i zam pa de'i thog nas sle bo rgyab tu khur ba'i rgan mo zhig 'dar cog cog ngang zam pa bsgral byung la/ bong bur shing skye bkal ba'i skyes pa dum zhig kyang lcag tshan 'phyar bzhin lung pa de'i thur du bshar byung / kho tshos da lta'ang srol rgyun gyi 'grul bzhud la brten nas deng rabs kyi 'tsho bar re 110
smyug rtse'i bzhur rgyun/snyeg byed pa las gna' rabs kyi bsam blo rmang gzhir byas pa'i deng rabs kyi bsam blo dang / re snyeg gi spobs pa rtsa ba nas 'char myong med pa 'dra/ltos dang / brjid nyams che ba'i lcags sgrom gyi zam pa dang / brtan zhing brling ba'i ar 'dam gyi zam pa ring mor brjid che ba'i rlangs 'khor de dag kyang 'ur sgra dang bcas shar skyod byed chog pa 'dug nga tsho'i mi rigs 'dir ches gna' dus nas zam pa bskrun pa'i lag rtsal dar ba'i ma tshad mi rigs 'dra 'dra'i khrod nas legs gras su gyur 'dug kyang da lta'i dus la deng rabs kyi zam pa bskrun nus rgyu phar zhog snga rabs kyi zam pa de 'dra'ang bskrun mi nus pa 'dir mno bsam zhib mo zhig mi gtong ka med lags/ zam pa tsam ma zad/ srol rgyun gyi sngon thon lag rtsal rnams nyams rgud du 'gro ba dang / deng rabs kyi lag rtsal nang 'dren mi thub pa ni nga tsho mi rabs 'di'i bag 'khums sgyid lug gi 'du shes las thob pa'i 'bras bu ngan pa de yin zhing / sa cha gang la'ang chang 'thung sho rgyag gi klong du g.yeng ba'am bag yangs lhod lhod ngang 'dug mkhan ni rang cag bod pa tsho red la/ lcags zam la brten nas chu bo'i pha rol gyi shes rig len rgyu'i bsam blo med par mes po'i shes rig phyir 'tshong byed rgyur 'bad pa sna tshogs byed bzhin pa'ang gang sar mthong rgyu 'dug cing / yab mes kyi blo rig de rang rigs yar rgyas kyi ched du mi bkol par gzhan rigs kyi shes rig phun sum je tshogs su gtong rgyur kha lag sems gsum 'dur mkhan yang nyung nyung min par snang /nga tshos lcags zam bsgral nas gna' dus su rgya dkar nag nas sdud 111
byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/ len byas pa des blo yid yongs su skong thub kyi yod pa yin nam/ yang na/ shes rig sdud len gyi lo zla snga sa nas yol zin pa yin/ mi rigs 'di'i gna' deng gi gnas bab la bsam gzhig byed dus nga tshos shes rig sdud len byed rgyu ni sngar dus las kyang dgos mkho che bar snang la/ lcags zam bskrun rgyu lta bu'i lag rtsal rgyun 'dzin dang / de bas legs su gtong rgyur 'bad pa byed rgyu de'ang mig mdun gyi dgos mkho gal chen zhig yin par ma zad/ tha na 'chi gson dang chags 'jig gi gdam ga nyag gcig kyang ma lags sam/bsam blo'i gtong phyogs nor ram ma nor rung / 'di ni/ yam yom dang khyar khyor byed pa'i gna' bo'i lcags zam gog hrul de dang / rtse mo cung zad lug pa'i zam sgo'i rdo mkhar mthon po de dag mthong rjes su babs pa'i bsam gzhig gi mig chu dwangs ma de'o/ /2011 2112
gangs ri'i bzhur rgyun/bshes gnyen tsho'i thugs la mnga' ba ni gting zab pa'i shes rig nor bu'i brgyang mdzod yin pa las/ nga rgyal dang khengs dreg gi chu rdzing min/ bshes gnyen tsho'i mdun du bsgrigs pa ni bam mthug pa'i dpe deb sna tshogs yin pa las/ lkog brngan du byin pa'i dngul dngos kyi rtsig pa min/ bshes gnyen tsho rgyun du 'grog sa ni grung hrig hrig gi blo gsal gzhon nu de dag yin pa las/ mgo skor byed rgyur mkhas pa'i g.yem ma mdo med de dag min/ bshes gnyen tsho'i phugs bsam ni mi'i rigs kyi bsam blo'i go rtogs mtho ru gtong rgyu de yin pa las/ nga che nga btsan dang rang rgyal gzhan pham gyi lta ba de dag min/
'brog thang gi mu zhabrel ring mo/'brog thang du log pa /nga brel 'tshub 'tshub kyi grong khyer nas skyo lhang lhang gi mig chu dku bzhin re sgug khrod kyi 'brog thang la log pa yin/ mi tshogs stug por bskyod pa'i sems pa blong blong de khur zhing / ngal ba ljid po de 'drud kyin rmi lam gyi mthong ka lta bu'i 'brog thang du log pa yin/ spang thang yangs po de brgal zhing / na gzhung kyag kyog 'ga' bcad de nga'i rmi lam gyi mthong ka lta bu'i 'brog thang du log pa yin/rgyang ring gi 'brog thang na smig sgyu'i rol rtsed 'khyab cing / chu klung gis glu sgra sgrog gin 'dug la/ dwangs bsil bsil gyi mtshe'u tshos bsu ma dang /ljang ldem ldem gyi ri klung tshos lag g.yug byed kyin 'dug da dung / tshul 'chos kyi ngo 'bag bral ba'i gangs ri dkar pos 'dzum mdangs ston gyin 115
byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/'dug la/ khongs dregs kyi zhwa mo phud pa'i spang ri sngo ljang des dga' bsu zhu bzhin 'dugmu med kyi rtswa thang du re'u lug gi 'ba' sgra snyan mo thos rgyus yod la/ rta nor lug gi ngur rgyang dang 'tsher skad kyang thos rgyu yod/ 'brog mi tsho'i lhad med kyi 'dzum mdangs dang na chung ma'i zur mig mdzes po'ang mngon srid/grong khyer gyi 'du 'dzi rgyang ring du yal 'gro la/ nyan mi bzod pa'i 'dzer sgra dang / mthong mi 'dod pa'i du zhag snom mi 'dod pa'i dri ngan mtha' dag rgyang ring du yal 'gro/gzigs dang / dar ljang gdan du btings 'dra'i rtswa thang gi steng du mu tig phreng ba 'dra ba'i g.yang dkar dang / dgong chen grib so gug 'dra'i nor gnag lhang lhang gre 'gyur snyan pa'i phyugs rdzi/ yod tshad nga'i mig lam du mngon dus dka' ba stong gis ghad mo grwanon mi thub la/ ya chung sems khong spro ba 'bum gyis mi khengs ci la srid gang /ltos dang / 'jam bsil bsil gyi rtswa thang gi rlung bu des a pha bgres po'i phyag zung bzhin kho bor byil byil gnang byung la/ 'od lam lam du 'phro ba'i rtswa thang gi nyi gzhon des a ma bgres mo'i bde 'jam pang kha bzhin kho bo'i lus la drod skyid sbyin byung / khod yangs pa'i rtswa thang nas me tog 'gas mgo lcog ldem pa ni nga la 'tshams 'dri byed pa dang 'dra zhing / mtho brjid gangs ri dkar po'i rtse mo nas lding yong ba'i sprin dkar 'di nga la bsu bar chas pa dang 'dra/ rtswa thang gi ri klung mthong dus/ ngas byis dus kyi bde skyid 116
gangs ri'i bzhur rgyun/slar yang dran byung la dga' ba dang skyid pa 'phel ba'i nyams snang de sgom chen gyi gtum mo'i bde drod bzhin nga'i glo snying brang gsum kun tu bde 'bol ler mched byung /'brog thang gi dpyid dus/skabs 'gar 'jigs su rung ba'i rdul dmar re ldang srid kyang / yid du 'ong ba'i re'u lug gi 'ba' sgras nga'i sems pa dpyid dpal la phyogs srid/ skabs rer rus rkang du zug pa'i grang ngar gyi mda' mo rnon po thebs srid kyang / a khu 'brog pa'i 'dris bde gshib bde'i mnyen 'jam rang ga shis des nga'i na zug yod tshad de mur 'jags srid/nga'i sems pa dpyid dus kyi 'brog thang la shor 'gro/ ri ma thang gi mgul nas khra rig rig gi lwa ba gyon pa'i a ce 'brog mos 'ur tshags kyi ram 'degs khrod nas rdzi glu snyan mo zhig dbyangs su gyer nges la/ na ma spang gi logs na re'u lug 'gas rtsed bror rol bzhin ma 'ongs pa'i lo zla bsu ba'i stangs stabs bsgyur nges/ brjid yer re 'gying ba'i rdza spang gi khugs so nas lha bya gong mos mgur dbyangs 'then nges par ma zad/ sngo mer re 'khyil ba'i mtsho mo pha gi'i kha nas khrung khrung mgrin nag 'gas kyang dpyid dpal bsu ba'i glu dbyangs len nges yin/dpyid dus kyi 'brog thang / gangs ri dang rtswa thang / rta nor dang ra lug117
byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/tha na bya byi'u/ phyi snod 'jig rten dang nang bcud kyi sems can yod tshad sgyu rtsal pa zhig ltar rang rang gi lus ngag gi rnam 'gyur la brten nas dpyid kyi dpal yon dbyangs su gyer zhing / mtshon ris su phab ste mi yul la mdzes sdug bsu ba'i sta gon rtsom par byed/dpyid dus kyi 'brog thang / rlon nem nem gyi kha ba de babs pa'i rjes su rlangs 'phyur 'phyur gyi smug pa ri rtser lding 'gro la/ snum mdangs shig shig tu bkra ba'i ri klung kun nyin re las nyin rer ljang mdog gi zhal ras mngon srid/ lhas rwa gru bzhi'i g.yas g.yon nas ma mo'i 'ba' sgra dang / ra ma'i re'u skad nyin re bzhin mang ru 'gro srid la/ phyugs rdzi ma'i bzho dbyangs dang / 'o ma 'jo ba'i shag sgra'ang nyin bzhin mang ru thos srid/'brog thang gi dbyar dus/ya gi'i gangs ri'i khongs gseng nas rgyug pa'i lung chu sngon mo de'i 'gram ngogs kun nas me tog sna tshogs kyis lang 'tsho ngom srid la/ pha gi'i spang thang bde mo'i thog tu kham ma gtsod kyis rtsed bro'ang rdung srid/ sbra nag gru bzhi'i g.yas g.yon du 'khor ba'i g.yang zog ni sgyu rtsal pa'i blos bslangs shig dang 'dra la/ phreng bar bltar ba'i ma mo'i khyu tshogs ni mkha' la lding ba'i sprin dkar nar mo dang ci 'dra'i mtshungs shing / shag shag tu 'bab pa'i 'o ma'ang sprin char zim zim zhig dang cis mi mtshungs/ ldem myur 118
gangs ri'i bzhur rgyun/'dzoms pa'i 'brog mo glog zhags dang 'dra zhes thal cha mi che la/ zur mig rnon po de ni ci 'dra'i mig la gzan pa zhig red gang /'brog thang gi dbyar kha/ gangs ri de bas dkar zhing brjid la/ spang ljongs de bas bkrag mdangs che/ mtsho dang mtshe'u de bas sngo zhing dwangs la/bya byi'u dang ri dwags kyi khyu tshogs de bas 'bel zhing yid du 'ong / phyugs rigs dkar nag sha shed de bas legs la 'brog mi tsho'i blo bag de bas mkha' ltar yangs/'brog thang gi dbyar kha/ ljang mdog gi spang thang bde mor skar tshogs sa la 'phos 'dra'i sbra gur phub nas sha mar thud kyi ro bcud longs su spyod pa'i dbyar skyid dang / rtsal drug ma lag bde ba'i pho gzhon tshos gyi ling rta mchog lcag gis skul nas khrung khrung gi gar rtsed rtse 'dra'i sgyu rtsal nyams 'gyur de dag mthong dus mi yul gyi 'dod yon longs spyod de las lhag cig gang na mchis ang snyam/dbyar dus kyi 'brog thang / rgyan gos kyis phyug pa'i na chung ma zhig dang 'dra ste/ char pa zam rim gyis ri lung yang yang bkrus shing / rlung bu bsil bsil des rtswa ljang yang yang shad de me tog sna mang gi rgyan cha btags shing /chu bo chung chung gi ska rags bcings nas 'dug'brog thang gi dbyar kha/ smug sprin lang long gi khrod nas/ char pa zam zim gyi dkyil nas/ mthing smug gi sbra chung la de bas snum zhag dod cing / g.yu mdog gi du ba de bas rgyang ring gi nam mkhar 'phur 'gro/119
byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/'brog thang gi dbyar kha/ snyan ngag rab rib cig dang 'dra bar 'grel bshad gsal po zhig rgyag mi thub cing / ri mo rab rib cig dang 'dra bar dkar nag phra zhib tu chod par ci 'dra'i dka' ang /'brog thang gi ston kha/'brog thang gi ston kha/ sgor mor bskor ba'i lhas ra de'i nang nas/rgyab 'di ru gangs ri spungs 'dra 'di/ /pha bzang bu lus bregs le red/ /mdun 'di ru ser gangs 'khyil 'dra 'di/ /pha phyug po tshang gi sgo zog red/ /ces snyan 'jebs kyi glu sgra mched pa 'di ni 'brog pa'i pho gzhon tshos lug bal 'breg skabs kyi las glu red la/ da dung / sbra nag gru bzhi zhig gi sgo 'khri sa nas/rgya mdong gser mdong khra mo/ /'o ma'i mar g.yang 'du shog/rgya yu lha shing shug pa/ /'o ma'i mar g.yang 'du shog/ces pa de ni 'brog mo na chung mas 'o zho dkrog pa'i las glu red/'brog thang gi ston kha/ nying 'jags kyi rtswa thang de 'khrug cha dod pa'i 120
gangs ri' bzhur rgyun/gar stegs ltar gyur pa'i dus tshigs 'di ci 'dra'i ya mtshan che yong mdzes sdug rnam par bkra ba'i gar stegs shig dang 'dra bar snyan mo ngag gi glu sgra gang sar lhang lhang du thos rgyu yod pas/ rna ba blags nas nyon dang / 'jol mo'i gre 'gyur lta bu'i skad sgra de ni spang thang bde mor sgor gzhas 'khyab mkhan gyi gzhon nu pho mo tsho'i skad ngag yin la/ gser mdog rab tu 'tsher ba'i ri klung kun tu grags pa 'di yang lha bya gong mo'i mgrin ngag ma yin par 'brog thang gi la glu'i drug 'gyur ring mo red/ da dung / phying ba rling ba'i las glu dang / 'o ma 'jo ba'i bzho glu sogs rang rang gi gru kha re re nas skabs dang skabs su gyer yong ba ni ci 'dra'i snyan zhing / ci 'dra'i yid du 'ong ba zhig red gang /'brog thang gi ston kha/ lhad ma 'dres pa'i 'brog mi'i gshis ka ltar nam mkha' sngar bas sngo zhing dwangs la/ sprin pa sngar bas dkar zhing mdzes/gser dang 'dra ba'i 'brog mi'i sems khams ltar sa gzhir gser mdog lam lam du 'phro zhing / chu bo rnams de bas dwangs bsil bsil du rgyu/ sprel lad bral ba'i 'brog mi'i rnam 'gyur bzhin phyugs rigs dkar nag dal dal du rgyu zhing / rtsi thog rnams mgo lcog ldem ldem du g.yo/'brog thang gi ston kha/ dkar chu'i rgya mtsho 'khyil zhing / mar gyi ri rab brtsigs pa'i dus tshigs/ phyugs rigs sha shed bzang la/ 'brog las thon zog 'dzoms pa'i dus tshigs/ rtsi thog 'bras bus lci zhing / chu bo bdud rtsir 'gyur ba'i dus tshigs/121
byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/'brog thang gi dgun kha/'brog thang gi dgun kha/ mda' las tsha ba'i grang ngar 'di mi sems la skul ma gtong byed kyi ngar shugs shig yin nam/ 'gran slong gi dran skul byed pa'i g.yab mo zhig yin/ skya thang thang gi ri klung skya mo 'di mi rtag dran skul gyi glog brnyan zhig yin nam/ mi tshe'i bgrod lam ring mor 'phrad srid pa'i skyid sdug gi nyams sad thengs shig yin/mang po zhig gis 'brog thang gi dgun kha ni mi yul gyi mya ngam thang zhig yin pa'i ngos 'dzin byed srid/ 'on kyang nga ni 'brog thang gi dgun khar dga' ba yin te/ de ni 'tsho ba'i lam 'phrang ring mo 'di dbyar kha kho nar nam yang gnas thabs bral zhing mtshams mtshams su dgun kha lta bu'i dka' sdug dang 'phrad srid pa ston pa'i bde sdug gi me long zhig yin la/ skyo ngal gyi lam 'phrang du bskyod pa'i lag len gyi dngos sbyong thengs shig yin/ltos dang / 'brog thang gi nor gnag de tsho dgun kha'i spu gri las rno ba'i grang ngar la ji mi snyam pa'i sgo nas lho byang gi dngos zog skyel 'dren las la dpa' ba dang / bcu zung bgrang bya'i them pa ma bud pa'i 'brog phrug de dag kyang dgun kha'i grang ngar dang 'ur rlung de dag bde skyid kyi glu sgra dang /mdzes sdug gi dpal yon du bsgoms nas kha glu dbyangs dang mi 'bral zhing /lag las ka dang mi 'bral ba'i sgo nas g.yang zog ra ba sgo bzhi 'tsho skyong 122
gangs ri'i bzhur rgyun/dang bdag gnyer byed lugs la ltos dang / de dag gis nga tshor 'dzad mtha' med pa'i spobs sems shig dang / stobs shugs shig sbyin gyin 'dug la/ ldid tig tig gi khur po zhig phrag steng du bzhag pa'i snang ba ster nges par ma zad/ glog 'khyug pa 'dra ba'i skul slong drag po zhig kyang ya chung sems su bsgo srid/'brog thang gi dgun kha/ gnas 'di ru spu gri las ngar ba'i grang ngar yod kyang zhed mi dgos te/ drag tu 'bar ba'i lco ba'i me sgong la lde rgyu yod/skya thul thul gyi kha ba bu yug 'tshub par 'jigs mi dgos te/ yid du 'ong ba'i sbra nag gru bzhi'i mal du gnas bca' rgyu yod/ skar tshogs 'dar ba'i lhags rlung yod kyang skrag mi dgos te/ shin tu dro ba'i bde 'jam pags slog gyon rgyu yod la/ khu sim pa'i mtshan mo'i ngam gnag la zhe 'tshab mi dgos te/rang gshis bzang ba'i a ce 'brog mo'i snying gtam la nyan rgyu yod/gang ltar/ 'brog thang gi dgun kha shar thengs re rer nga la sngar med pa'i blo stobs dang / skul ma bzang po re thebs nges yin la/ mi sems 'gul ba'i snang tshul sna tshogs shig kyang nga'i mig mdun du mngon srid pas/ nga la mtshon na 'brog thang gi dgun kha ni ci 'dra'i mkho che ba'i yar skul gyi lcag tshan bzang po zhig red yong /123
'brog thang gi gangs ri/shel dkar gyi mchod rten bsgrigs pa ltar brjid nyams ldan pa'i 'brog thang gi gangs ri de dag ni mtho sgang gi chu mdzod mtho lcog yin la/ go la hril po'i zungs khrag gi 'byung khungs kyang yin/gzigs dang / ltar sgo dkar po/ gnyan chen thang lha/ jo mo rgyal gangs/shel yer gangs ri/ bsam gtan gangs bzang / sku lha dar mdung / spu de gung rgyal/ sga stod jo bo/ phyag rgya jo bo shel dkar/ gsa' phu mgon lha dkar po de ltar ya gi'i gangs dkar ti se nas ma gi'i rma rgyal spom ra'i bar du bgrang las 'das pa'i gangs ri'i gral bltar bsgrigs nas yod la/ brjid chags yid 'ong gi gang sa ri re rer bod mi rigs kyi mes po gong ma tshos lha ri dang / gnas ri gang rung gi mtshan snyan gsol nas yod pa dang / gna' nas da bar du gangs ri de dag gis sa gzhi ril mor tsha ba'i grib bsil dang / skom pa'i gdung sel gyi legs skyes rlabs po che bskrun yod/brjid chags kyi gangs ri tshos dwangs bsil bsil gyi g.ya' chu bsil ma'i bzhur rgyun de kha ba can nas brgyud de mes rgyal nang sa'i mdzes sdug gi ri lung la ro bcud snum po mkho 'don byed cing / 'dzam gling hril po'i khod yangs pa'i zhing thang dang / mtha' stug pa'i nags tshal/ mdzes sdug ldan pa'i 124
gangs ri'i bzhur rgyun/yul ljongs kun tu zungs khrag gi bzhur rgyun ring mo stsol bzhin yod/dgongs dang / 'dzam gling gi chu bo yong gsum par bgrangs pa'i 'bri chu kham pa dang / rang rgyal gyi chu klung yong gsum par 'bod pa'i rgyal mo rngul chu/ ya gling khul gyi chu bo ang bzhi par 'bod pa'i zla klung phyug mo sogs bzhur thag spyi le stong phrag du ma'i yan du zin zhing / bzhur stobs spyi khre rgya dpang gru bzhi ma khri tsho 'ga' zin pa'i chu bo bgrang las 'das pa zhig mtho brjid gangs ri dkar po khyed cag gi nu zhos bskyangs pa sha stag ma yin nam/ gzhan yang /stod kyi kha 'bab chu bo rnam bzhi dang / smad kyi rma klung nor bu dga' 'khyil/bar gyi lha sa'i skyid chu sngon mo rnams kyang chu mgo 'brog thang gi gangs ri nas bzhur ba'i chu rgyun kho na yin la/ sog chu sngon mo dang / shag chu kham pa/dbyug chu sngon po/ rtsa skya gtsang po sogs gtsang phran stong dang chu phran 'bum phrag gi 'byung khungs kyang khyed cag kho na lags/da dung / lta na sdug pa'i gangs ri re re'i 'og nas brdol ba'i gangs chu dkar po'i bzhur rgyun gyis yid du 'ong ba'i mtsho mo re re ltems mer bskyil yod pa ni/ gangs dkar ti ses ma pham g.yu mtsho dang / ltar sgo dkar pos dwang ra g.yu mtsho/ gnyan chen thang lhas gnam mtsho phyug mo/ jo mo rgyal gangs kyis skya rengs klu mtsho/ gsa' phu mgon lhas gsa' mtsho khra ring sogs yin zhing / de dag so so rang rang bzhin lhun grub tu byung ba zhig rtsa ba nas ma yin par/ kho tsho nam yang mdza' gcugs brtse dung zab pa'i bza' tsho yin pa dang / 'jig rten mi yul gyi skye bo rnams dang 'dra bar dga' sdang zhen 125
byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/'dzin gyi 'ching bas bcings pa las brjod mi tshar ba'i lha sgrung rid mo re ris bskrun nas yod/'on kyang / nye ba'i lo shas nang khyed cag gi gsham nas bzhur 'ong ba'i chu bo de ri klung char pas ma brlan kyang rung / kha bas sa gzhi'i kha dog ma bsgyur kyang rung / sos dbyar ston gsum kun la drod tshad mtho ba'i nyi 'od 'og tu drag tu 'phyur ba'i rba klong dang bsdongs nas rgya ja kham pa zhig gi kha dog 'dzin bzhin 'dug la/ bltas bltas rig rig tu da lta'i dus su khyed cag tshos mdzes sdug yid 'ong gi ka ci ras dkar gyi na bza' phud de/'jigs su rung ba'i brag rong dang / rdza ri ngo nag cig gi rang gzugs mngon yong ba de ci zhig gi snga ltas yin nam/ de snga'i gangs khrem sbug de da lta rdza khyem sbug tu gyur nas 'dug la/ grwa ba'i ming can gyi sa 'edzin mang po zhig rog po'i ming can du ma bos rang bzhin du chags nas 'dug ltos dang / ma gi'i sga stod jo bo'i lwa thod phud nas 'dug la/ pha gi'i kong gwa ba'i zhal ras bco lnga'i dung zla de yang smug nag mchong gi kha dog 'chang bzhin gda'/ da dung de mus su khyed cag gis mdzes sdug ldan pa'i phying lwa phud nas sku lus gcer bu'i brtul zhugs bskyangs tshe ma yum sa gzhi'i tshe srog gi khrag rgyun yang bskam nges yin la/ mi'i rigs kyi skom sol kyi dwangs ma de yang rang gi mig chu kho na las lhag srid dam/126
'brog thang gi spang thang /'brog thang gi spang thang / me tog dkar dmar gyi ri mos mdzes shing sngo ljang g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing khams/ ngam grog g.yang gzar gyi dri ma bral zhing khod yangs bde 'jam 'bol pa'i phyi snod bzang po/ ri klung thang gsum kun tu rtsi thog sna tshogs kyis mgo lcog ldem pa'i rang byung khor yug bsang me dmar po'i du zhag mkha' ru 'phyur zhing kri bswo ho gsum gyi 'bod pa 'brug ltar grags pa'i gnas mchog g.yu sbra mthing gshog dgung dgu rngam brjid kyis 'gying zhing 'ur rdo phyed mig dgu sgril gyi tshag skad brag car mched sa/gna' snga mor khyed kyi phang ba de rta mchog gi bang khas 'dom la 'jal zhing /stong lug khyu tshogs kyis dog mor btang myong la/ nor gnag gis nyin srib brjes shing / ra tshe tshe yis rtsed bro rgyun chad med par 'khyab sa/ da dung 'brong g.yag gi ngar sgra'i kha rlangs 'thul myong la/ gtsod gdong nag gi rwa kha rtse zhing / rkyang kha dkar gyi rmig bro brdungs myong /yin na'ang / rno skud kyi dra bas so sor bgos shing / sbag sbag 'khor lo'i stong sgra dang / rlangs 'khor gyi du zhag gang sar 'phyur ba'i kha sang de ring gi skabs su/ gtsod kham ma'i khyu tshogs ston chu bzhin bri zhing / 'brong bre lo'i ngar sgra rgyang ring du yal bzhin 'dug la/ rkyang kham ma'i rmig bro'ang dgun gyi khu byug ltar shin tu dkon/127
byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/sbra nag gi chon phur snga sa nas bsdus shing / 'ur tshogs kyi sgra skad snyan mo'ang brag cha dang mnyam du yal zin/ khal g.yag gi ru bltar lo rgyus su gyur zin la/ ba rdo spun gsum gyi bar nas 'phyur ba'i du zhag de yang lcags dkar gyi sbubs su drangs zin/bltas bltas rig rig gi ngang la/ sngo ljang gi rtsi thog nam langs skar tshogs ltar yal bzhin 'dug la/ phon bzang rtswa ljang 'thor bu nas thar thor du 'gro bzhin 'dug thal rdul gyi mdung ring dus bzhir 'phyur zhing / bye zegs kyi 'jag skyas skyo glu ring mo zhig gang sar len la brel nas 'dugrtswa thang gi bla srog tu grags pa ste/ khyod kyi pang nas 'bral bar mi phod pa'i g.yang mo lug khyu dang / nor gnag gi khyu tshogs kyang 'dzer sgra sgrog pa'i 'phrul 'khor gang zhig gis rgyang ring gi dmyal khams su drud song la/ gces su 'os pa'i tshe srog re re bzhin dmar mdangs bkra ba'i sgor khug gang zhig gi lto bar 'khyil song /'brog thang gi spang thang / la gzhas snyan mo ngag tu 'gug cing 'ur rdo phyed mig dgu sgril gyi tshag skad ri klung kun tu 'khrol bzhin dngul dkar sor gdub snying nye nye'i ngang brang khar sbyor mkhan gyi 'brog mo dkyus ma de tsho dang / bag rta ngang pa lding shes kyi gong nas zhe dungs dungs kyi phyi mig 'jog bzhin bco lnga'i dung zla 'dra ba'i bzhin ras kyi ngogs su stag sha ra zhig gi dpa' stobs sgom mkhan de tsho/ khra khra khrig khrig gi pags lha'i gong nas mda' las rno ba'i zur mig gi lcags kyu rnon po 'phen mkhan de tsho/ da lta/ yas nas 128
gangs ri'i bzhur rgyun/stod thung gi sham sne mchan khung las ma grol zhing / mas nas gos thung gi gong ba sta zur las ma grol ba'i hreng hreng gcer bu ma'i sgeg nyams ngom khul byed mkhan nyin bzhin mang du 'gro bzhin 'dug la/ rta mchog gi rmig sgras gnam sa g.yo zhing bya rgod ding gling gis brtse 'dang 'gug mkhan gyi stag shar de tsho 'phrul rta gang rung zhig gi gong nas rol dbyangs skyur mo zhig gi dbyangs rta len bzhin mchis/'brog thang gi spang thang ya/ khyod kyi phang ba ru grong khyer gyi gad snyigs g.yos byung la/ spang thang las 'khrungs pa'i gser sha lta bu'i gzhung drang gi sems pa de/ nag nog du dreg cig gis shog bu snum zos su 'gyur bzhin gda'/'brog thang gi bsil rlung /bsil rlung de a ma'i bgres mo'i phyag ltar mnyen la/ yab chen bgres po'i ngag bzhin 'jam/ bsil rlung de ldang thengs re rer/ sngo mer 'khyil ba'i mtsho mo g.yas skor du skyom srid la/ rtswa ljang gi lo ma ldem ldem du g.yo srid/bsil rlung des mag mog gi smug sprin bshus nas brjid chags rtswa thang gi gangs ri mngon par byed pa dang / bsung zhim 'thul ba'i rtswa thang gi dri zhim gang sar mched par byed nges/ bsil rlung de nga'i glo snying la ldang bas sems pa rtswa thang du 'khor song la/ me tog gi dri zhim bsnams nas gang sar ldang 129
byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/bas phyogs bzhi'i skyes bu'i blo kha'ang rtswa thang la phyogs song /khyod rang / mig zung dam por btsums nas bsil rlung la gdong gtad tshe lang long du 'phyo ba'i rnam shes la gzer tsag sbyin nges la/ nag nog gi sems par yabang byi dor byed nges yin/ bsil rlung des rtswa thang gi bya dang byi'u yi skad snyan rgyang ring du khur bar ma zad/ rtswa thang gi dwangs gtsang sems pa'ang thag ring du khyer song / bsil rlung des/ rang rong gi lam bu khod yangs su bskyed song la/ rab rib kyi mun pa ther tshal du btang song /bsil rlung des/ nyi 'od kyi dpal yon bsus nas mun 'thoms kyi skye bor 'od gsal gyi lam sne bstan zhing / lam lam du 'bar ba'i me lce'i 'od snang khur te tshor med kyi lus por bde drod cig bstsal song /bsil rlung des/ tha na ches khug kyog tu lus pa'i gad snyigs dag kyang dmar rjen du bton zhing / lo mang bsags pa'i bye ma'i ri de'u de yang nam mkha'i dbyings su gtor song / nying 'jags ser 'khyil ba'i rtswa thang gi mtsho mo der yang rba rlabs drag tu g.yos byung /'brog thang gi chu bo/'brog thang gi chu bo de dag lo ngo dung phyur du mar chags pa'i srid pa'i gangs dang kha ba'i bzhur rgyun yin la/ lo ngo dung phyur du mar 'khyil ba'i brjid chags mtsho dang mtshe'u kha lud yin/ ljang mdog rab tu 'tsher ba'i 130
gangs ri'i bzhur rgyun/lung shur nas lhung lhung dal gyis 'bab pa'i chu bo de ni 'brog mi'i sems khams ltar dwangs la/ 'brog mi tsho'i rang gshis ltar sbag btsog bral/ chu bo 'di'i chu mgo ya gi'i gangs ri gnyan chen thang lha'i khong gseng nas mched cing / chu gzhug ma gi'i gnam mtsho phyug mo'i gong ba ru zug pa ni mi rigs shig gi zungs khrag gi bzhur rgyun dang 'dra la/ tshe srog cig gi rmu thag dang yang ci 'dra'i 'dra/ lung chen re re'i srubs na chu chen re bzhur bzhin yod la/ thang chen re'i hrag bar na mtsho chen re sngo mer re 'khyil yod mod/ sbra nag gi kha srubs nas mngon pa ni zhag tshil gyi 'od snang kho na las mthong rgyu med la/ ngam gnag gi rtswa thang 'dir mtshan mo'i skar 'od ma gtogs ci zhig mthong srid dam/'brog thang gi chu bo/ mes po tshos yab mes kyi zungs khrag tu bsgoms myong la/ lha dang klu yi zhing khams su'ang bsgoms myong bas mtho sgang gi dwangs gtsang chu mdzod ces pa'i mtshan snyan thob par ma zad/ 'dzam bu gling gi lhad ma phog pa'i dwangs gtsang chu bo'i cod pan zhes kyang ngang gis thob/ khyed ni gtsang chen brgya yi chu mgo yin la/ mtsho dang mtshe'u stong gi ma ma'ang yin/bzhur sa 'brog yul nas yin yang 'bab sa rong yul du yin pas khyod kyi bzhur lam 'od chem chem gyi glog sgron la srog zungs sbyin par ma zad/ gral bltar 'grig pa'i bzo grwa 'ga' la nus stobs mkho 'don byas pa'ang bgrang gis ga la longs/ 'on kyang / rang nyid kyi bzhur mgo 'brog thang 'di ci 'dra'i khu sim dang / lhing 'jags kyi gdod ma'i mal du da dung 'jog don 131
byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/ci/ gcig byas na khyod kyis deng rabs dang dngos po'i dpal yon gyi zog zob dri mas ma bslad pa'i khor yug dwangs gtsang gi mtshan snyan mu mthud du 'jog 'dod yin las che/'brog thang gi la gzhas/me tog gi mgo lcog ldem pa'i spang khud cig nas/ 'ur rdo lag tu bzung ba'i phyug rdzi gzhon nu des/glu len na pad ma bka' thang len/ /bka' re re klogs dang gnyis gnyis yod/ /glu len na thang chen bco lnga len/ /thang re re bud dang gnyis gnyis yod/ /glu len na gos chen brgya lteb len/ /lteb re re shigs dang gnyis gnyis yod/ /ces pa'i snyan mo'i dbyangs rta de thos byung ngam/ kho tsho'i mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo nas glu yi 'gyur khugs ni pad ma bka' yi thang yig ltar brjod bya dang rjod byed mi 'dra ba'i gcig min du ma yod la/ mu mtha' bral ba'i byang thang yangs mo dang 'dra bar thang re re bud na gnyis re mthong lam du mngon srid/ kho tsho'i snyan mo glu yi bang mdzod de dga' sdang zhen 'dzin gyi snang ba rlung la spur byed yin la/ a 'thas skyo gdung gi na bun 132
gangs ri'i bzhur rgyun/sangs par byed pa'i gzugs med kyi dri bzhon de yin/ mdza' mthun yid gdung gi ki 'bod rgyang ring du bskur ba'i sgra dung yin la/ yun ring yid la nyar ba'i gsang ba brda ru 'god pa'i yig chung de'ang yin/'brog thang gi la gzhas/ rlung gis lhab lhub tu rdeb pa'i la mgo'i dar cog zad po dang mnyam du skyo gdung gi skad sgra 'dzer po zhig dang 'grogs nas 'brog mi'i tsho'i sems pa'i na zug rlung ril bskur zhing / gting zab pa'i grog rong gi nang nas lhung lhung du bzhur ba'i g.ya' chu'i 'bab sgra de dang 'grogs nas mtho sgang gi dung dbyangs gang sar sgrog par byed/'brog thang gi la gzhas/ khyed kyi tha snyad re re 'brog pa'i mes po'i tsho'i snying khrag gi dwangs mas 'bris yod la/ khyed kyi lhang lhang gi dbyangs rta re re 'brog pa'i mes po'i tsho'i dga' sdang zhen 'dzin gyi rtogs pa'i mgur ma ngo ma de yin pas / khyed kyi lhang lhang dbyangs rta mched sa nas yab mes tsho'i dka' sdug gi rdul khrag bzhur myong yod la/ bde skyid kyi me tog kyang bkra myong yod/ khyod ni 'brog mi tshos gsol ba'i lha ri 'gangs chen de'i rtse mo nas zhabs su sprul ba'i dar thag ring mo de dang 'dra bar yab mes gong ma tsho'i nang sems kyi 'dzin stangs rnams da lta'i mi rabs bar du sprul ba'i rig gnas kyi rmu thag ring mo de lags/'brog thang gi la gzhas/ glu dbyangs ni mi'i rigs kyi lo rgyus dang kha bral thabs med la/ lo rgyus ri mo yod tshad glu dbyangs dang 'dra/ nga tshos la gzhas kyi dbyangs rta ring mo'i khrod dang / la klu'i ngag tshig snyan mo'i khrod nas bor 133
