byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/shing / gdon dang 'grul sna'i rigs kyang me yis srung bar snyam/me ni 'od zer stong phrag 'phro ba'i khri gdugs nyi ma zhig dang 'dra bar mi'i rigs la mun sel gyi dpal yon sbyin bzhin yod la/ rdo rje pha lam gyi go khyab dgu brtsegs shig gam gzhom gzhig bral ba'i lcags mkhar btsan po zhig ltar mi'i rigs rnams 'jigs nyen gyi 'phrang lam du ma nas bskyabs yod/ me yis 'das pa'i lo rgyus mtshon phyir brag phug gi ya thog tu dud dreg gi zhabs rjes bzhag yod la/ na thang ma gi'i gong na ri ltar mtho ba'i go thal gyi phung po spungs yod/① me/ rdo ba rdog gsum gyi gong bar nas nar son zhing / lcags sgyid dang sog thab/ wa thab du ma'i skyor ma las lang tsho rgyas te/ glog thab spyod pa'i da lta'i dus rabs kyi bar du mi'i rigs la skyid dus dga' skyid kyi gsol ston 'dren rogs dang / sdug dus skyo gdung gi skom pa sel rogs byas shing / tha na nad kyis mnar dus su sman chu tsha mo'ang khyod kyis skol ba las gzhan ci/gcig byas na/ khyod la zhan cha'i rang bzhin yang ldan pa ni/ skabs 'gar/ na bun 'khrigs pa 'dra ba'i nags tshal gyi phung po thal rdul du gtong ba dang / mdzes sdug yid 'ong gi khang bzang khri stong du ma nag hur hur du gtong mkhan yang khyod yin la/ gtum drag che ba'i 'bar rdel dang / sdug rtsub che ba'i rdul phran mtshon cha'ang mthar gtugs na khyod kyi dpung skyor med pa min/ sbag btsog ldan pa'i dug rlangs kyis nam mkha' bsgribs nas skye bo'i lus khams nad kyis gcong du 'dren mkhan yang khyod kyi yang tsha yin 148
gangs ri'i bzhur rgyun/la/ zil rngam che ba'i 'phur rdel gyi nga ros zhi bde'i dpal yon 'joms skabs kyang khyod kyi mthu nus grogs su ma sbran pa min/legs na skye 'gror bde dga' drod skyid kyi dpal yon sbyin mkhan yang khyod yin la/ nyes na tsha bsregs gzhob gsum gyi sdug gcod gtong mkhan yang khyod yin pas/ nga tshos me nyid legs nyes du ma'i 'byung rtsar 'gyur du 'jug mkhan de btsal nas/ blang dor gyi bslab bya nan po zhig 'don dgos pa ma yin nam/ /2005 11ji149
byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/shing phor/shing phor gang / 'di ni deng rabs 'phrul las kyis bzos pa'i dkar yol 'brug ma min la/ gna' dus yul gru gzhan nas thon pa'i g.yang ṭi'i dkar po'i phor pa'ang min par/ bdag gi yab mes gong ma gang rung zhig gis phyag bzo 'khrul med las bskrun pa'i shing phor dngul shan ma zhig yin/go thos su phor pa 'di bskrun ched kho bo'i mes pa gong ma zhig gis ri chu khri stong brgal nas nags tshal gyi gling phran mang po nas phor pa bzo rgyu'i shing cha bdams shing / nyin mtshan du ma'i ngal ba khyad du bsad nas lugs bzo dkrug rgyag gi lag rtsal spyad de bskrun par ma zad/ mdzes sdug ldan pa'i dngul shan spras pa dang / yid du 'ong ba'i ri mo'i brkos dkrol brgyab pas da gzod nga tsho'i mi rabs nas mi rabs su brgyud pa'i shing phor dngul shan ma de byung bar skad/phor pa de ni mthil rgya che bas rgya cog gru bzhi'i steng du bzhag na brling 150
gangs ri'i bzhur rgyun/zhing brjid chags la/ kha zheng srab pas za 'thung gang rung longs su spyod sa byas na bro ba lhag par che ba/ ri mo legs pas bltas na yid du 'ong zhing mig la mdzes/ bshad rgyun du/ phor pa de longs su spyod mkhan gyi mdzangs blon mi bdun gyis mtho sgang gling du gsar btod kyi sgo mo phyes shing / mi rje srong btsan sgam pos bod khams dar dkar yug dril du gcig gyur la bkod/mdzangs blon mgar stong btsan gyis phor pa de khur nas 'un shing kong jo khab tu bsus shing / mdzangs blon thon mi sam bho ṭa dang / g.yu thog yon tan mgon po sogs nas phor pa der shes rig gi ri mo sngar las mdzes par byas phor pa de'ang lo rgyus kyi chu rgyun ring mo'i nang du dka' sdug gi 'gag 'phrang sna tshogs brgyud cing / dar rgud kyi ri mo sna tshogs brgyud dgos byung yod stabs/ phor pa de'i ngos 'ga' nas mdzes sdug gi ri mo nag nog tu gyur cing / srab 'jam gyi phor kha'ang rdib chag 'ga' zhig btod 'dug de bas zhe skyo dgos pa zhig ni rigs rgyud khrel med 'ga' yis phor pa der bdag gces dang brtse ba dor nas snang med du bskyur ba'i rkyen gyis phor pa de'i mthil zhabs dag la ser ris chung ngu re gnyis kyang babs 'dugphor pa la rdzab ya dngul shan ma dang / mnga' ris klu mes ma/ khams pa'i spen rdzab ma/ dwags po'i bla phor ma sogs shing ris mdzes la dngul shan legs pa'i shing phor de tsho tsam ma zad/ da dung / yab mes tsho'i blo gros dang shes rig las 'khrungs pa'i gra nang dkar yol dang / chab mdo'i de'u dmar gan dkar sogs bod dkar mang po yod la/ tha na ches gdod ma'i dus kyi 151
byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/'dam phor me so ma dang / ko phor skas ris ma sogs kyang mi rigs 'di bsam blo'i na tshod thog mar smin pa'i dus kyi bskrun dngos legs po zhig dang / phor pa kun gyi yab mes ngo ma yin stabs/ go thos su bod pa'i ko phor skas ris ma zhig gna' bo'i bskrun dngos legs shos kyi thog nas 'dzam gling dngos rigs shul bzhag gras su tshud par thos/ngo ma/ nga phor pa der gces shing zhen pa'i rkyen gyis 'gro dus dar gyis dril nas rum du bcug pa dang / 'dug dus cog khar bzhag nas kha zas longs su spyod yul byed la/ tha na rang nyid bod pa tshang gi rus rgyud cig yin pa'i mtshon byed la yang phor pa de nyid 'jog gin yod/ rnam kun phor pa der gces pa'i nga rang mtshan mo gnyid du yur ba'i skabs su'ang phor pa de rmis byung / rmi lam gyi nang du/ mi tshogs mang po'i khrod du kho bos phor pa de nyid mthon por btegs nas rigs 'dra min gyi ja chang sna tshogs longs su spyod pa'i skabs der/ rang rigs las gzhan pa mang po zhig gis khyed kyi phor pa der zhib 'jug gi rin thang chen po ldan 'dug zer ba dang / phor pa der thun min gyi khyad chos ldan 'dug zer ba/ mi'i rigs kyis bskrun pa'i phor pa bgrang med kyi nang nas phul du byung ba zhig red zer ba sogs kyi gdeng 'jog sna tshogs byed bzhin 'dug la/ phyi rgyal mgo ser ba zhig gis phor pa de nga la tshongs dang ngas deng rabs kyi dkar yol dang / shel phor spus legs brgya phrag sprad chog zer ba dang / yang gzhan skad smra mkhan mgo nag cig gis phor pa de kho tsho'i yul du 'khyer te nyar tshags byas na ma gtogs 152
gangs ri'i bzhur rgyun/khyod tshos bdag nyar byas na de bas nyams rgud du 'gro srid zer ba sogs bstod bsngags byed mkhan dang / kho tshor 'thob 'dod kyi 'gram chu ldang mkhan mang po 'dug na'ang / rang rigs pa tsho bstod bsngags byed du yong mkhan gcig kyang ma mthong bas kho bo ya mtshan skyes te/ gang sar mig nyul zhig byed skabs rang rigs pa de tshos gsar du thon pa'i dkar yol dang /shel phor/ tha na gu gu sha'i phor pa dag zhe dungs dungs kyis lag tu blangs nas 'dug la/ de dag gi dge mtshan yang chang gis bzi ba'i lab brdol bzhin cha mi tshang bar dam dum re skyor bzhin mchis/ ngas rang rigs pa zhig la rang re'i pha mes kyis bskrun pa'i shing phor dngul shan ma der kha zas longs su spyad na legs tshul gleng skabs/ khos shing phor der kha zas longs su spyad tshe lo ngo stong phrag gi shing dri rnying pa kha srid la/ kha sang de ring du phog pa'i dngul gyi g.ya' dri'ang yod srid/ de las deng rabs 'phrul las kyis bskrun pa'i phor pa 'di dag legs zhes shel phor phyi gsal nang gsal zhig bstan byung / ngas khyod kyis gzhan rigs kyi phor pa gsar rnying 'di tsho'i legs cha dang len byed pa bzang na'ang / pha mes kyi 'thung phor patsog par brtsi ba ni ma rabs tha shal ba zhig red ces brjod dgos snyam tshe/ mgrin pa brnangs nas skad cha tshig gcig kyang ma thon pa'i skyo shas skad cig ma de'i shugs kyis gnyid las hob sad brgyab byung /de ni rmi lam zhig rang yin rung / kha sang de ring bltas bltas rig rig khrod nas gces su 'os pa'i pha mes kyi shing phor pazang po de je rnying du 'gro 153
byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/ba'i snang ba zhig sbyin bzhin 'dug mod/ drang mor zhus na gas zin pa'i ser ris de dag gsub pa'i thabs shes ma mchis shing / nogs zin pa'i ri mo de dag bskyar gso byed pa'i nus pa kho bor rtsa ba nas med par ma zad/ tha na zad zin pa'i dngul shan la bug dol re gnyis yod par ji ltar byed dgos min shes kyin mi 'dug pas gces su 'os pa'i mes nor der bdag gces zhes pa de yang kho bor mtshon na don ngo mar kha stong pa tsam du lus 'gro ba ni/tsan dan gser bas brin che ba/ /blun pos sol bar byas la ltos/ /zhes pa'i dpe bzhin chags mi yong ngam snyam pa'i zhed snang skyes so/ /2011 3—154
bshes gnyen/ 'bras bu'i khur gyis lci ba'i shes rig gi sdong bu/mi zhig la mtshon na mi tshe gange bor 'gro 'dug spyod gsum gyi lam ston gnang mkhan gnyis dang 'phrad srid pa ste byams ldan gyi pha ma dang / mkhyen ldan gyi bshes gnyen gnyis yin la/ kho tshos long bar mig dang lkugs par smra lce bstsal ba lta bu'i bka' drin bskyangs pa las/ rang cag rnams bya ba gang la'ang bden rdzun legs nyes 'byed pa'i spobs pa dang / bzang ngan dkar nag gi lam bu gang yin dpyod pa'i blo nus ldan par gyur/gna' nas da bar du shes rig gi sgron me bzang pos 'jig rten khams kyi mi shes mun pa'i tshogs kun snang bar byed mkhan sgron me lta bu'i yon tan can dang / nam mkhar bsnyegs pa'i tshan rig lag rtsal gyi ljon bzang rtse nas mkho dgu'i 'bras bu bzang po chad med char du bsnyil mkhan gyi tshan rig mkhas can/ de bzhin slob gso mkhas can dang / chab srid mkhas can/ sgyu 155
byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/rtsal mkhas can zhes ming gi snyan pa dbyar kha'i 'brug ltar grags shing / mi'i rigs la phan bde'i gru char 'gyed mkhan gyi skye bo de dag thams cad bshes gnyen bzang pos shes rig slob ston gyi gru gzings nang du bzhag nas/dka' sdug gi rba klong drag tu 'phyo ba'i mtha' med 'tsho ba'i chu gter zab mor gdams ngag gi skya ba 'degs pa'i lag len la sbyong brdar sprad du bcug myong ba sha stag yin pas/ kho tsho tshang ma'i grub 'bras legs po de dag chung byis pa'i dus nas bzung bshes gnyen bzang po'i slob ston dang kha 'bral thabs gtan nas med/soms dang / bshes gnyen bzang po ni dwangs gtsang gi chu bo zhig dang 'dra bar skye bo'i tsho'i shes rmongs kyi skom gdung sel pa dang / le lo dang sgyid —lug gi nag nog 'dag par byed pa yin la / bshes gnyen bzang po ni sra mkhregs ldan pa'i mkhar gyang dag dang 'dra bar log lam gyi gcong rong du mi lhung bar 'gog nges shing / ma rabs ngan spyod kyi grang rlung mtha' dag srung bar byed/ bshes gnyen bzang po ni thig shing thogs pa'i shing bzo mkhas pa zhig dang 'dra bar gzhon nu lo chung tsho'i bsam spyod lus gsum 'dra gtub ngal brgyas yid 'ong gi mkho chas sha stag tu bskrun la mkhas pa dang / pir smyug bzung ba'i lha ris pa zhig ltar ya rabs spyod bzang gi mdzes ris sna tshogs 'god la dpa'/ bshes gnyen bzang po ni nam mkhar bsnyegs pa'i 'bras ldan ljon bzang dag dang 'dra bar ya rabs spyod bzang gi lo 'dab phyogs su brkyangs shing / shes bya yon tan gyi sil tog mngar mo 156
— gangs ri'i bzhur rgyun/phangs med du bcus te mi'i rigs la bsam pa'i rgyags phye snga na med pa re spro bar brel/bshes gnyen tsho'i bskyod shul du mtshar sdug rnam par bkra ba'i mdzes ldan gyi me tog mang la/ mi sems 'gul bar nus pa'i gzhan phan gyi gtam rgyud mang / bshes gnyen tsho'i mig mdun na 'bras bzang khur du lci ba'i tshar bu'i phon po mtho la/ ya rabs gshis bzang gi ma 'ongs rgyud 'dzin bgrang du mi lang ba mchis/ bshes gnyen tsho'i bzhugs khang na bab chags tshul ldan gyi yid 'ong khor yug mod la/ rna bar nyan par 'os pa'i slob gso yi glegs bam rngam mthug bshes gnyen tsho'i mi tshe ni 'od zer lam lam 'phro ba'i rta bdun dbang po nyid dang mtshungs la/ yongs rdzogs gzhan don du legs skyes 'bul mkhan gyi sa smyug rkang gcig dang 'dra/bshes gnyen tsho'i thugs la mnga' ba ni gting zab pa'i shes rig nor bu'i bang mdzod yin pa las/ nga rgyal dang khengs dreg gi chu rdzing min/ bshe sa gnyen tsho'i mdun du bsgrigs pa ni bam mthug pa'i dpe deb sna tshogs yin pa las/ lkog brngan du byin pa'i dngul dngos kyi rtsig pa min/ bshes gnyen tsho rgyun du 'grog sa ni grung thig hrig gi blo gsal gzhon nu de dag yin pa las/ mgo skor byed rgyur mkhas pa'i g.yem ma mdo med de dag min/ bshes ga nyen tsho'i phugs bsam ni mi'i rigs kyi bsam blo'i go rtogs mtho ru gtong rgyu de yin pa las/ nga che nga btsan dang rang rgyal gzhan pham gyi lta ba de dag min/157

byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/bzhugs tshe/ nam zhig nged spun bdun sogs mdo dbus mtho gzhongs kyi rang byung sman rdzas 'di dag lha sgrung du dngos su gyur nas/ bshams ston dag gi nang du ri mo tsam las ston thabs med par nges la/ mdo dbus mtho sgang gi sa gzhi ril mo 'jigs su rung ba'i mya ngam thang zhig tu 'gyur rgyur the tshom ci/ zhes zer bar/ za 'og gos chen ljang gu'i phyu pa gyon zhing / ser po gser gyi glo gzung 'phyang 'phrul du btags pa dang / dar lham dmar ljang shur ris can zhabs la gyon pa/ rin chen dang po'i rigs lnga dbu la gsol ba'i g.yas g.yon du dkar ser mthing gsum mdog can gyi dar 'phyang dang / mu men gyi tog dang ldan pa/ 'khor du rang 'dra'i na chung dkar ser sngo dmar sogs kha dog rnam par bkra ba bdun gyis bskor ba'i lha mo stong ri zil pas 'di skad do/ /gcen mo lags kyis gsungs pa shin tu bden/ nga ni sngon tshe rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dus la slob dpon pad ma mchog gis tshad rims rtsad nas 'joms pa'i gnyen por mnga' gsol zhing / sbyor sdeb sman thun re re la gser srang stong ri'i rin thang ldan par gsungs pas na/ ming yang stong ri zil ba zhes su btags nas gtso 'khor bdun gyis sa sgang ril mo'i 'gro ba mi'i rigs la tshad rims bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nyer 'tshe 'gog pa'i phan bde'i 'gro don 'gyed dgos pa'i bka' bsgos lung ston byas pa zhig yin/'on kyang / dus rabs nyi shu'i dus mgo nas bzung ste/ bzang byas bzang byor mi tshor ba'i mgo nag re 'ga' ham sems kyi dug chang nag pos drag tu 172
zungs khrag gi bzhur rgyun/myos te/ 'jigs su rung ba'i deng rabs 'phrul 'khor sna tshogs kyis gser ldan ma yum sa gzhi'i brang gzhung gshags nas don snying nang khrol lta bu'i rin chen gser dngul zangs lcags rnams 'don pa dang / zungs khrag bzhur rgyun 'dra ba'i g.ya' chu zil ma rnams 'bag btsog gi dri mas sbags par byas/ za 'og dar gos 'dra ba'i spang gzhong phyug mo rnams phying ba dril dril du gtong ba'i las ngan la nyin mtshan khor mo yug tu bya rgod bem por rol ba 'am/ skyag sbrang gsang spyod du 'khor ba ltar lo nas lor 'bad pa'i nyes pa las/ da cha nged gtso 'khor bdun po yang 'ga' re stong la nye ba'i mtshams su bslebs nas/ lha rje tshos tho 'god byas pa'i stong la nye ba'i rtsa che'i rang byung sman rdzas kyi gras su gyur yod/ des ma tshad nga'i mtha' 'khor du sngar dus yod pa'i zil rngam che ba'i 'brong g.yag dar ma dang / lus stobs bzang ba'i se le gnyan/ bang 'gros mgyogs pa'i kham pa gtsod bcas kyang re tsam las 'dren byed lam du mi mngon par gyur/ da dung kho tsho 'gro ba mi rnams stag gzig sram thul gyis btums pa'i phyu chen gyon nas rgyan gos 'gran sdur yin zer/ gtsod khul gyi ske dkri dkris nas yo rob phyug bdag yin par rlom/ srog chags kyi mgo bo bsgrigs nas mi rigs shig gi mtshon rtags su ngom par snyam pa'i rang mthong gi nga rgyal de dag ci 'dra'i glen pa gti thug cig red yong / don du 'dzam gling go la'i khyon du sngar med pa'i 'bag btsog gi mkha' dbugs dang / char ba skyur mo/ ba tshwas bslad pa'i 'thung chu sogs kyis ngos mi zin pa'i nad rigs dang / 'gog thabs 173

zungs khrag gi bzhur rgyun/dang / khyed gnyis ka yum chen gser ldan dga' mas sa steng mgo nag skye 'gro thams cad dbul phongs kyi gnas las grol ba dang / nad med yun du 'tsho phyir mtho sgang ril mo'i 'byung khams snyom sgrig dang mkha' rlung gtsang smo bzo'i ched du skyed sring byas pa zhig yin zhing / khyed gnyis nas da bar rang don yid byed bral ba'i sgo nas rang rang gi phul du byung ba'i khyad yon sna tshogs sngog 'don gyis mi'i rigs la bla na med pa'i phan bde bskrun pa ni gong du khyed rang gnyis kyis gleng ba ltar yin mod/ 'dod sred rmongs gsum gyis kun nas bcings pa'i 'gro ba mi'i rigs 'dis 'phral gyi bde ba kho na longs su spyod ched/ shog sgor brtsegs ma'i don du nyin mtshan dbyer med 'dur rgyug gis ma 'ongs 'tsho gnas ched du bsam blo skad cig tsam yang mi gtong bar rtswa dang rtsi shing / chu bo dang mtsho rdzing / 'dab chags dang ri dwags sogs brko rgyu thams cad brkos/ 'breg rgyu yod tshad bregs/ 'dren rgyu yod tshad phyogs mthar drangs pas/ dwangs gtsang gi chu mgo bskams/ rnyog bral gyi gtsang chab nyog srog chags kyi skye rgyud stong / gzhan yang 'brog pas phyugs zog 'tsho skyong dang / zhing pas sa zhing bdag gnyer byed pa'i snga rabs kyi goms srol bzang po phal cher nub pa dang / lo chung gzhon nu rnams kyang bzang por mig ltos med par ngan pa'i lad mor shor nas pha ma dang dge rgan gyi bka' slob rgyab bskyur dang / rgyab khab kyi khrims lugs dang 'gal ba'i bya ba byed par ma zad/ mi la sgor mo yod na gang la'ang 'dzem zon dang /gus bkur byed mi dgos pa'i rang snang gang shar dang / khrims med lugs 191
byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/med/ phu dkrug mda' dkrug gi snang tshul 'ga' zhig thon bzhin yod pa ba lu me tog khyed kyis gsungs pa bden pa yin mod/ de dag ni nu bo dbyar rtsa dgun 'bus byas pa zhig ma yin par mi'i rigs kho rang tsho'i rang nyid lan pas red/ 'on kyang / da lta kho tshos sngar byas kyi nyes skyon mang po zhig tshor rtogs sgos go la hril po'i skye khams khor yug srung skyob dang / 'byung khams snyom sgrig rgyun sring 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i thabs jus sogs ma 'ongs par phan nus ldan pa'i bya thabs mang po lag bltar byed pa'i 'char gzhi bkod rkapar ma zad/ dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu rko lugs thad la'ang phan nus ldan pa'i bca' khrims bton te gcig nas dbyar rtsa dgun 'bu rko skabs skye khams khor yug la gnod skyon mi phog pa dang / gnyis nas nang gyod phyi 'khrug gi kha mchu rtsod gleng mi yong ba'i 'gan len sgrig yig bzos pa dang / gnyis nas rin gong lugs mthun dang / tshad ldan du gtan 'bebs byas pa dang / sa cha gtan khel sar khrom ra bzos te nyo tshong stabs bde dang / rdzun ma spus zhan gyi rigs mi yong ba'i sngon 'gog gi thabs lam bton pa bcas dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu'i gnad don dang 'brel ba ldan pa'i tshod lta'i khrims srol mang po sa khul so sor gtan 'bebs byas yod la/ rgya che'i mang tshogs tshos kyang rang rtogs kyi sgo nas 'bu brko'i sa char gad snyigs ldug sa 'bru ba dang /'gyig shog gi rigs gang byung du mi skyur ba/ skye dngos gzhan dag la gnod 'tshe phog tshad chung du gtong gang thub byed pa'i bsam blo'i 'du shes sna tshogs skyed sring byed bzhin yod/ da dung zhing phyugs bskyur nas dbyar rtswa 192
zungs khrag gi bzhur rgyun/cidgun 'bu rko 'thu gcig pu 'tsho rten du 'dzin pa ni rgyun sring 'phel rgyas kyi 'thab jus dang mi 'tsham zhing / zhing 'brog mang tshogs rnams 'phral gyi bde bar dmigs pa'i mig rgyang thung ba'i thabs lam zhig la ngos bzung ste/ slad phyin zhing phyugs gsar 'dzin byed dgos pa'i blang bya'ang 'don bzhin 'dug de ltar na yang / go la thil po'i khyon du sgor mo kho na gtso bor 'dzin pa'i 'du shes da dung shugs je cher song nas/ tha na mi'i thob thang bzang ngan dang / dga' bkur 'dzin lugs de sgor mo mang nyung dang / go sa mtho dman la bstun nas dbye ba 'jog bzhin yod pa las nang bsam pa'i kun spyod bzang ngan dang / rig gnas shes bya'i yon tshad mtho dman la mnyam 'jog byed mkhan nyung bar ma zad/ bya ba gang zhig sgrub na'ang sgor mo mang nyung ci yong la bsam blo gtong ba las mi rabs rjes ma'i tshe srog yun gnas dang 'brel ba che ba'i rang byung khor yug la gnod 'tshe ji yong dang / mi chos kun spyod las 'gal bar do snang mi byed cing / sgor mo yod na yod tshad blos gtong gi bsam blo'i shugs rkyen ngan pa nad yams bzhin gang sar khyab nas yod pas nga tshos dus dang rnam pa kun tu mi chos kun spyod kyi bsam blo'i slob gso dang / skye khams ma lag srung skyong gi 'du shes 'dzugs rgyu gal chen yin pa'i dran skul byed dgos gal shin tu che/ zhes brjod do/a pho 'brug grags de yud tsam ring srog med dngos po de dag kha ta byed lugs la ha las shing nyon thor nas 'dug pa dang / slar dran shes sor r+nghidu chud skabs/ a ho ho/ nga tsho mgo nag mis ma yum gser ldan sgeg mo'i 193
byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/bka' drin la bsam shes med par sgor mo kho na'i ched du skye khams khor yug la gnod pa'i bya ba mang po las par srog med skye dngos de dag kyang smra ba'i sgo mo dbang med du phye dgos par gyur 'dug ang / de sngon rang nyid nas kyang ci bsam 'di bsam med par gzhan rjes su 'brangs nas sgor mo kho na'i ched du thal drags pa'i bya ba mang po zhig byas pa de dag kho tshos brnyan ris su phab pa bzhin shes 'dug da nas sngar byas rgyab bskyur gyi sgo nas skye khams srung skyong bya rgyu de mi rabs rjes mar phan pa'i gal che'i phugs bsam zhig yin pas rgyun sring 'phel rgyas thabs jus la brda lan zhus te/ phyugs zog 'tsho skyong dang / sa zhing 'debs 'dzugs kyis tshul mthun lugs mthun gyi mi zhig bya ang snyam pa'i bsam blo zhig bcos min yid la 'khor nas chu shog sngon po de sa dong zhig tu sbas rjes/ mig mdun du mnga' ba'i dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu de yang ma bsngogs par shar re khyim du log go /2009 6ji194

byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/ljongs chen 'dir/ da cha shes rig gi pha khyim sngar mus ltar zin thub pa phar la bzhag ste/ rang skad gtsang ma'i gzhung lugs kyang mtha' 'khyongs shes mkhan dkon pa'i tshod du gnas yod pa 'dra/ rgyal yongs kyi gtso gnad gna' shul rig dngos kyi gras su gtogs pa'i btsan po'i bang sor bsleb la nye ba'i 'phred bkal sbyar yig cig tu sku nyid bod rje'i bang so gzigs pa 'phebs rgyur 'ga' bsu bzhu :zhes yig 'bru bcu grangs las med pa'i khrod du yig nor g.yag ro 'dra ba gsum gyis zin pa dang / de yang rgyal khab rim pa'i gna' shul grags can gyi yul skor bsu tshig yi ger thon pa de las rang gi pha skad gtsang ma'i gzhung la mkhas pa'i shes ldan pa mang nyung ci tsam yod pa rtogs thub la/ da dung rtsed thang khrom srang gi g.yas g.yon kun tu de dang 'dra ba'i yig nor dang / 'gyur skyon can gyi sgo byang ha cang mang /2rang ri'i bod pa 'di nam yin yang bya ba gang dang / dngos po gang la yang brtag zhib byed pa'i goms srol nyag phra zhing / rgyu mtshan rtsad zhib dang 'tshol rtog gi blo kha shin tu dman pa ni nga tsho'i rjes lus kyi 'byung rtsa dngos de yin mod/ da lta'ang 'jur mig dog mo de las thar thub med pa ni dgon pa so so'i dge 'dun pa rnams nas rang so so'i dgon pa'i lo rgyus zur tsam yang mi shes pa dang / skya bo rnams nang chos la mos pa de yang blun dad kho 196
zungs khrag gi bzhur rgyun/na'i lam du 'gro bzhin 'dug de yang smin grol gling gi lho ngos ri sgang du dar lcog 'dzugs sa dang bsang gtong yul gyi gsas mkhar zhig 'dug par/phran nas yul de'i skyes pa zhig la/ pha gi ga re red dam/ zhes 'dri skabs/ 'o/'di rtsa chen mo zhig red da/ zhes zer ba las rtsa che ba'i rgyu mtshan dang / yang na de'i lo rgyus sogs gang yang shod rgyu mi 'dug rung / da dung nga la rang der phyin nas bsang thongs dang yag po yod red ces rmongs tshod sgos nga la'ang blun dad skul gyin 'dug3 rang re tshor rnam kun kha byang lag byang du las la brtson pa'i bod rigs zhes snga 'dang dang phyir 'dang til 'bru tsam yang med par 'bri shag shag gi goms srol zhig mchis mod/ don du mgo la mi 'dza' ba'i zhwa mo zhig dang mtshungs par snang ste/ji gna' dus su bod rigs rnams las la brtson 'grus ldan pa zhig yin du srid rung / da lta'i dus kyi rang re rnams ni chang 'thung rgyan skugs kyi 'khyams po lang shor dang / sgyid lug mal sar 'gre ldog rgyag rgyur mos pa'i klad stong tag tag gis gang 'dug cing / bod mi'i 'byung khungs dang / mkhar las 'dzugs skrun gyi 'byung khungs/ zhing sa 'debs skrun gyi 'byung khungs sogs 'byung khungs du mar rlom pa'i lho kha'ang de las ma 'das par snang ste/ lam zur gyi tshong khang phal che ba mi rigs gzhan pas 197
byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/btsugs 'dug la/ rdal gtong 'khor chung gi kha lo ba yang bod rigs shig btsal nas rnyed dka' mor snang / tha na dgon 'dabs kyi kha btags tshong mkhan dang / mchod mar tshong mkhan gyi khrod du bod rigs nyung gras yin pa lta bu'i snang ba zhig sbyin 'ong gi 'dugbod rigs tsho ni sgrom stegs spo lor mgo 'khor nas 'dug pa'am/ lam zur gang rung du sos dal ngang gtam gleng 'then pa dang / gsol ja mngar mo 'thung bzhin nyi mar sro nas 'dug pa dang / mi rigs gzhan pa tshos btsugs pa'i sdong las khang nang g.yog tu 'dug pa kho na las ma 'das shing /rang nyid kyis rang stobs sgo nas tshong las kyi lam bur zhugs pa'am/ las rigs gzhan dag 'bad pas skyong ba ni ches shin tu dkon pa'i tshod du gda' ang /4gang rag 'thung ba ni mi chos las 'gal ba zhig ma yin rung / rang re'i bod pa tsho ni chang rag 'thung na 'thung tshod mi zin zhing / chang rag 'thungs rjes ra bzi bar khag dkris nas mi gzhan la 'khrug rtsod slong rgyur shin tu dga'/ kho bo'i pha yul nag chu sa khul la mtshon na chang rag tshod med du 'thung mkhan mang la/ ra bzi'i dpa' nyams ston mkhan de bas kyang mang /kho tshos chang rag gi bzi kha'i klong nas la rgya dang / snying stobs yod mdog 198
zungs khrag gi bzhur rgyun/gis stong gtam sgrog bzhin pha ma spun mched dang / grogs po snying nye su la'ang 'dzem dogs med par pha khrag ma khrag gi ki 'bod 'debs srid/ shes rig gi 'byung khungs su grags pa'i lho khar yang sa rub tsam du khrom lam la phyin na chang dri 'thul zhing / gom pa 'khyor ba'i skyes bu mang du 'dug la/ tha na lam 'gram du sems med bam ro ltar 'gyel ba'ang re 'ga' snang /de na nga tsho'i chang 'thung dpung tshogs ni dgos pa med pa'i mi tshogs shig dang 'dra la/ spyi tshogs la gtor bshig gtong mkhan gyi ru dpung de 'dra med na a re dga' ba la/5'dzam gling khyon gyi 'phel rgyas bla nas bla ru 'phags shing / 'gran rtsod sna tshogs kyi gom kha nyin re las nyin rer su mgyogs su spo ba dang / rang stobs rang spel gyi bya bzhag sna tshogs sgrub la rngam pa'i dus 'dir/ kha ba'i can gyi gzhon dar mang po zhig gis sgrig sho dang / shog sbag sgrom stegs spo lo khang sogs rgyan 'jog gi do ra sgrig nas thob shor gyi 'gran rtsod gleng zhing /nga rgyal khyod pham gyi rtsod gleng de'i steng du bslebs tshe dga' nye spun mched kyi 'dzem zon tsam yang med par dngul khug nang gi shog bu ham 'phrog kho nar brtson/ nyin mtshan rgyan 'gyed klong du rnam par 'khyams te/ brtse ba'i pha mar sri zhu sgrub mkhan med par gcig pur nang du lus shing / snying du nye ba'i bu 199
byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/phrug lo brgyad ma son pa dag kyang g.yul sa der khrid nas mig ltos ngan pa bslabs/ mthar thug gi 'bras bur pha mes kyi bsags pa dang / rang gi lto rgyab tshun chad ci med 'di med du phar la bskyal nas pha ma'i re ba chu la bskyur zhing / bu phrug gi mdun lam stong bar gtong ba ni ci 'dra'i lam srol ngan pa zhig ma red ang / bod pa'i bstod tshig 'bul yul shes rig 'byung khungs kyi lho kha de yang da cha rgyan 'gyed kyi pha sa zhig tu 'gyur bzhin yod pa 'dra ste/ dpe mdzod khang dang dpe tshong sogs rig gnas do ra ches nyung ba'i steng du srang lam mang po zhig la rol rtsed khang chen mang po'i sgo byang gi mdzes sdug ngom nas 'dug la/ de dag gi nang du yod pa ni kha ba ri ba'i gzhon dar rnams yin 'dug grogs po zhig gis brjod pa ltar na/ rgyan 'gyed kyi g.yul sa der zhugs mkhan lho kha ba'i skyes pho mo mang po yod pa dang / kho tshos rgyan 'gyed gyi 'gran rar zhugs thub tshe su la'ang bsam gzhig mi byed par ma zad/ tha na rang gi lto rgyab tshun chad g.yul 'gyed de'i dgos mkhor gtong bzhin yod skad 'dug6gzhan rten lto 'tshol gyi slong mo ba'i dpung tshogs ni bod kyi sa cha gang sar yod cing / kho tsho'i gras su lang tsho dar la bab pa'i stag shar gzhon nu dang / sman chung bu mo yod la/ dbang po dman lhag log skyon gyi na tshos ma 200

dbyar kha/dbyar dus/ mdzes sdug rnam par bkra ba'i dus tshigs de ni/ rgya mtsho'i gos can ngo mtshar 'bum gyis dpal yon bkra shing / yid la spro ba sbyin pa'i nam zla zhig yin pa dang / skabs der 'brog pa rnams kyis me tog sna brgya bkra zhing gos chen ljang gu btings 'dra'i rtswa thang thog tu ci dgar rol ba'i phyugs rigs dkar nag dal bur 'tsho zhing / dkar chu 'o ma'i rgya mtshor gang 'dod du longs spyod byed/ so nam pa rnams kyang zhing thang skya mo 'bru rigs sna lnga'i snye rlabs dgung la 'phyur ba dang / sngo ljang g.yu lo bkod pa'i nags tshal stug po'i khrod kyi ljon pa'i grib bsil du glu gar chang 'thung gi rtsed 'jor rol ba'i sgang yin/dus tshigs 'di la snyan ngag mkhan po tshos kyang 6yid la spro ba sbyin zhing /dbyar gyi dpal yon rgyas pa'i skabs su zhogs pa'i chu zil gyi 'dzum bag las brtse ldan mdza' mo'i bzhin ras dran yong〉〉zhes rjod kyin yod/ 'on kyang / dbyar gyi dpal yon ni yud tsam yin pa dang / de kho nar rol rgyu yod pa ma yin par dgun gyi grang ba dang dpyid kyi lhags rlung mi ring bar 'char nges pas de dag gi dka' sdug las rnam par rgyal thabs la 'bad dgos pa dang / de bzhin du dbyar gyi dpal yon dang mtshungs pa'i gzhon nu'i lang tsho dar skabs su'ang rang snang gang dran gyis bag med bde dga'i longs spyod 207

byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/yod tshad khong du chud pa'i glog ris kyi me long bskrun/ chu 'dzin stug po'i klong du'ang 'phur lding gi gar stabs bsgyur/ le dbar khri 'bum gyi sa ru'ang mdza' brtse'i snying gtam gleng / gnyis 'thung dbang po'i rgyab khal khri phrag du ma'ang dus gcig la dbor thub pa byung /da dung / nam mkhar bsnyegs pa'i thog brtsegs khang chen dang / pa tra'i ris can gyi gzhung lam/ lta na sdug pa'i skyed tshal/ mig 'phrul lta bu'i bzo grwa la mtshan can gyi rdzas dngos/ yod tshad ngal rtsol khri stong du ma brgyab pa'i shul lam nas thon pa'i yid 'ong gi mdzes ris sha stag yin/ ngal rtsol gyi 'bras bus slob ma rnams mkhas pa'i go sar bkod/ mkhas pa rnams kyis gsung rtsom gyi brag ri brtsegs/ blun po rnams kyi spyang grung gi sge'u khung phye/thos chung rnams la kun gsal gyi sgra dung thob/ nyam chung rnams la dpa' stobs kyi go cha bgos/ long ba rnams la kun gsal gyi snang ba shar/ zhing pa rnams kyi bang ba 'bru yis khongs/ 'brog pa rnams sha mar gyi mdzod gnyer du gyur/ tshan rig mkhan tshos 'phel rgyas kyi dpal yon bstsal/ zhib 'jug pa tshos grub 'bras kyi dar rtags 'phyar/ gtso 'dzin pa tshos 'byor ldan gyi rgyal khab bskrun/yod tshad kyi yod tshad/ ngal rtsol gyi zhing sa nas 'khrungs pa'i mdzes ldan gyi me tog rkyang rkyang yin/ ngal rtsol med na 'phel rgyas med la re ba'ang med/ gson shugs med la dpal yon med/ mdun skyod med la deng rabs med/ ngal rtsol med na yod tshad lhing 'jags yin la nyam chung yin/ le lo 220

tshe srog gi bzhur rgyun/zhes pa nas yin pa dang / chung ngu'i skabs nas a ma tshe las 'das shing / a pha des ma ga yar zhig blangs pa dang dwa phrug yin pa'i rkyen gyis dka' sdug sna tshogs nyams su myong dgos byung zhing / mthar rang lo bcu skor nas khor khyim du bud de yul shul 'bas tsha sde ba'i dpon nag tshang drag po zhes pa'i g.yog por brgyugs skad/ 'jig rten mi yul gyi las dbang zhes pa de ni ci 'dra'i do mi snyom pa zhig red ang / skabs de'i dus su mtsho sngon khul ni mā jag gis dbang sgyur byed skabs yin stabs/ shin tu lngi la rnam grangs mang ba'i khrul rigs sna tshogs bskul ba'i rkyen la brten nas 'thab rtsod 'khrug slong gi rtsod ldan dus ngan shugs je cher song bas bdag gi a pha'i mgo dpon nag tshang drag po zhes pas sne khrid de 'brog pa ru shog bsgrigs nas stod rgya gar gangs ri'i phyogs su thon/kho tshos byang thang gi grang ngar che ba'i gshong sa brgyud nas bskyod pas lam bar du phyugs rigs rnams grang ngar mi bzod pa dang / tshwa chu ma gtogs 'thung chu med pa sogs kyi rkyen pas phal mo che shi god du gyur rabs 'dug pas a phas bkres ltogs dang / dka' sdug gi sdug bsngal bgrang las 'das pa myangs yod pa ni smos ci dgos/ de ltar/ ru ba bros byol gyi 'grul bzhud ring mo de mi lo gsum tsam brgyud mthar stod rgya gar gangs ri'i mdun du 'byor zhing / de gar ru ba'i skyes pho mo tshang mas bod pa spyi mtshungs ltar sems kyi dad mos rum gang gi blo stobs la brten nas rang rang gi lus stobs bzang ngan dang / khom pa legs zhan dang bstun nas mang du bskor 225
byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/mod/ khyim tshang gzhan gyi g.yog la rgyug pa'i a phar mtshon na ru ba'i skyes pho mo gzhan dag dang bsdur thabs bral bas/ mi lo bzhi la nye ba zhig gi ring du gangs ri'i mdun du bsdad kyang skor ba thengs dgu las 'bul ba'i khom skabs ma byung /do mi snyom zhing spyi tshogs kyi sgrig lam dang khrims srol zhan pa'i spyi tshogs su 'tshar longs byung zhing / ya rabs ma rabs kyi spang blang ston mkhan med pa'i a phas kyang ru ba'i jag pa gzhan gyi ngan slob dang / mig rkyen ngan par brten nas jag rkun 'phrog bcom gyi las la zhugs myong yod cing / a pha rang gis bshad pa ltar na/ rang lo bcu gsum tsam nas bco lnga'i bar gcig pur ru ba tshugs mal bca' sa nas rta tshugs kha shas yod sar phyin te nor gcig gnyis re rkun 'ded byas myong yod pa dang / skabs rer ra mdas rjes chod nas rang gi dpon nag tshang drag por de don yar zhu byas pa'i rkyen las rkun dngos phyir bslogs par ma zad/ rta lcag tsha bo lan 'ga' yang bzed myong yod/ yin na'ang / de ni chung dus mi gzhan gyi mig rkyen ngan par brten nas byas pa las/ phyis su jag rkun phar zhog lam nas rnyed pa'i dngos po dag kyang do bdag su yin rtsad bcad nas bdag por sprad pa ngas thengs 'gar mthong myong yod/ de ltar jag pa dang rkun ma mang ba'i ru sgar de'i mi rnams nas stod kyi tsho sde gang sar thob na jag dang / ma thob rku ma lan mang byas pa'i rkyen gyis kho tsho phyir log pa'i lam la mnga' ris skor gsum nas bod dmag tsho zhig dmag skul byas te/ de snga'i nag tshang tsho drug(deng skabs 226
tshe srog gi bzhur rgyun/nyi ma rdzong khongs)gi sa cha brgyud skabs nyin zhig zhogs par ru ba yongs rdzogs dmag mis mtha' bskor nas rgyobs gsod kyi nga ro gang sar grags byung bar/ rnam kun rkun jag 'phrog bcom las la zhugs mkhan gyi jag pa ming can rnams rang gi snying nye ba'i nang mi rnams skyob rogs mi byed par rang mgo gang thon du bros pa dang / de'i 'phror ru ba'i skyes pho mo rnams 'jigs skrag dngangs gsum gyi ngu 'bod gang sar sgrog skabs/ ru ba'i dpon nag tshang drag pos kho rang gis bod dmag tshor ya lan sprod pa'i go skabs dang bstun nas ru sgar gyi skyes pho mo rnams phyir 'bro dgos pa'i slob ston 'og tshang ma rang mgo gang thon du bros par/ dpa' dang blo khog 'dzoms shing ru mir brtse ba'i dpon rgan de dmag mi'i mtshon 'og du 'das grongs song yang ru ba'i skyes pho mo phal che ba srog nyen las thar tsam byung / 'on kyang / khyim nang gi rgyu nor tsam ma zad/ sgo zog rnams kyang yongs rdzogs shor bas gnas skabs shig gi rings gad skyibs su gnas bcas shing / sa cha de ga'i yul mi tshor lto slong byed dgos pa'i sprang po sprang nag tu gyur/de ltar stod la thon pa'i skor gyi a pha'i gtam rgyud de dag kho bos thos myong yod stabs/ dus phyis nag tshang nus blo'i rang rnam mthug po der zhib lta byed skabs/ a pha'i gtam rgyud de dag blo la lam lam du 'khor yong /nang gi nom rgyu dang / phyi yi sgo zog gong gi mgo dpon/ bar gyi sbra rogs yod tshad dgra la shor stabs a phas skabs shig ring ci byed 'di byed med par rdo la ma ṇi brko ba'i lag rtsal sbyangs nas rdo bzo 'dra byas te bkres 227
byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/ rdzogs gyis mnar ba'i pho ba dab ga 'khyalhas grab gis 7rtsas pa'i lus po lhaso thabs kyang byas myong /las bskos zhes pa de yang dngos gnas gzur thabs bral ba zhig yin pa 'dra ste/ skabs de shed cig la tshwa len du yong ba'i rgan po kun dga'(nag tshang tsho drug gi ma yo tsho ba'i rgan po zhes pa'i dpon chung)zhes pa zhig a phar thug pa dang / des kho rang gi phyugs zog 'tsho mkhan du yong dgos pa'i skad char nyan nas skabs der rang lo bco brgyad las ma son pa'i bdag gi a pha nag tshang tsho drug gi ma yo tsho ba zhes pa der stes dbang du 'byor/skabs der bdag gi a phas/ rang re'i bod 'di shar nub kyi skad la khyad par che bar brten skad cha mi go ba dang / hor rgog dang hor 'khyams zhes pa'i brnyas bcos sna tshogs nyams su myangs dgos byung yod la/ khyu 'bor che ba'i phyug po 'di tshang gi khyu zog 'tsho skyong gi dka' ngal sna tshogs la'ang gdong len sprod dgos byung yod stabs rab gi pha yul du log 'dod kyi 'dun pa shugs chen byung bar ma zad/ log rtsis kyang thengs kha shas byas rung / da lta bzhin deng rabs kyi 'grim 'grul rna ba'i yul la'ang go myong med pa'i dus der/ srol rgyun 'grim 'grul la brten dgos stabs rgyang thag ri chu khri stong gis chod pa'i gnas su sprang phrug gcig pur 'gro ba'i spobs pa bag la mi zha ga la srid cing / lhag par gnyen nye rnams lo shas ring stod bros shar log gi 'khrug 'dzing sna tshogs khrod gang sar thor gyar du song bas pha yul la'ang brtse ba'i gnyen nye gang zhig yod pa'i gdeng tshod med stabs/ pha 228

brtse 'dang gi bzhur rgyun/ma zad/ 'dug stegs shig la u tshugs kyis sdod du bcug nas yong don bka' 'dri gnang bzhin gtam gleng gi mgo btsugs shing / dgod sgra dang gus zhabs/ tha na lag pa'i phyag rgya'ang byang cha shin tu ldan pa'i sgo nas sne len byas song la/ nga ni khang pa de'i nang du yod med tsam yang ma rig pa ltar byas stabs mgo bo g.yug g.yug byed bzhin phyir log mi byed ka med byung /de nas bzung nga ni ngo ris dpyad la mkhas shing / ngo ris la bltas nas bya ba sgrub par mkhas pa zhig nas ngo ris la lta ba'i khrod du rang don 'phyugs shing / ngo ris la zhen kha log pa'i mi bu zhig tu gyur song bas ngas sngar gyi bsam blo la 'gyur ba btang ste ngo ris brtag la su zhig mkhas pa dang / ngo ris brtag lugs ji ltar byed kyi yod min thad do snang byas pa na/rang nyid ni ngo ris lta mkhan rnams kyi khrod nas bslab pa rgan gras yin rung / lta stangs zhan shos su gyur 'dug pa tshor/ dus rabs gsar pa'i ngo ris dpyad mkhas pa de dag mi tshogs mang po'i dkyil nas kyang su zhig phyug pa dang / su zhig mgo khrid yin pa/ su zhig skye bo spyir btang yin pa dbye 'byed gnad la khel ba byas te gus bkur zhu sar gus bkur zhu ba dang / khro gnyer bstan sar khro gnyer bstan bzhin gzhung don 'ja' tshon bkra bkra dang / rang don 'bras bu 'thu 'thu byed shes kyi 'dug la/ ngo ris mkhas pa'i deng rabs mi bu de tshos ngo sha rgyags rid dang / dkar dmar gyi snum mdangs bkra zhan tsam ma zad/ ngo ris kyi rgyab nas mngon pa'i go gnas dang / dbul phyug tha na ltag sgo legs nyes sogs re re bzhin shes lugs la 275
byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/bltas na mi re re'i bzhin ras ni phyi gsal nang gsal gyi me long zhig yin pa min nam snyam pa'i dogs 'char yang skye srid/ da dung / kho tshos mi zhig de snga 'byor zhan nas da lta 'byor ldan zhig yin pa'i bar dang / de snga go gnas med pa zhig nas da lta go gnas 'phar zin pa'i bar gyi ngo ri sa khyad par 'byed shes la/ de bstun gyi skad cha lab stangs dang rnam 'gyur bstan stangs kyang ma 'phyugs gnad du 'khel par ston shes/ngo ris brtag dpyad byed mkhan mang ba'i stabs kyis tha na dpon po tshang gi hā pa spu sob de yang ngo ris lta stangs mkhas par gyur yod pa 'dra/khos gyon par ral rdol mang zhing / gdong sha skam la rid pa'i skyes bu su zhig mthong rung ngar ngar dzig rdzig sgos shor yong gi 'dug la/ tha na nywa shar so 'drad rgyag rgyu yang the tshom mi 'dug mod/ 'od mdangs 'khyug pa'i 'khor chung gang rung nas gdong sha rgyags la grod khog lug pa'i skye bo su zhig thon rung rna cog grong grong dang rnga ma zhum zhum gyis 'dris yog byed yong bar ma zad/ 'od mdangs bkra ba'i ko lham de la'ang lce ldag rgyag gin 'dugde ltar ngo ris brtag la mkhas pa zhig nas ngo ris la lta ba'i spyi tshogs khrod pham kha nyos pa kho bo ngo ris la zhen pa log cing / snying rlung ldang mod/ ngo ris kyi dpyad rtsal sngar las je mkhas dang / ngo ris dpyad par spro mkhan sngar las je mang du 'gro bzhin 'dug par ma zad/ ngo ris bzang ngan so sor spre'u'i zlos gar 'khyab lugs de yang je bzang je legs su 'gro bzhin 'dug pas/ rang nyid nas bzung ste rgan rabs tshos ngo ris lta lugs kyi srol 276
brtse 'dang gi bzhur rgyun/ngan btod par 'gyod sems shig ngang gis skyes byung yang bya thabs ci la yod yong / /2009 3ca277
'ur rdo/gna' mis spyad pa'i thag zhags 'gug ma las grub pa'i skyogs rdo'i 'phrul 'khor khyod/ sngon thon gyi mtshon cha zhig tu ma bsgoms pa ci la srid de/mtho sgang gi phang bar sku bltams pa nas 'thab 'dzing gi zil shugs kyang skad cig 'phel bar byas yod nges red la/ tha na dus rabs nyi shu pa'i dus mgor yang khyod nyid mtshon cha ngar ma zhig gi tshab tu bzung nas rdzi yi dgra bor kha gtad bcag par skad/nor lug gi bal khul las bzos pa'i sbo' skad ldan khyod/ rgyus med mi pho zhig la mtshon na khyod kyi drag shugs che ba'i ngar skad de ni ci 'dra'i zil rngam ldan pa zhig red yong / 'on kyang / 'khris su bcar na tha gu 'gug ma zhig gi gzugs brnyan 'dzin pa der su zhig gis mtshon char ngos 'dzin byed srid dam/gang ltar/ khyod kyis lo rgyus kyi chu rgyun ring mo'i nang du mgo nag bod mi 278
brtse 'dang gi bzhur rgyun/dang 'grogs nas dpa' dang dpung pa'i lang tsho bskyor nas mi rigs shig gi zil rngam bstan myong la/ ri dwags g.yung dwags su phab par yang blo dang thabs kyi grogs su zhugs yod par nges pas khyed ni kha ba can gyi lo rgyus kyi rmu thag 'khrul med cig dang / yab mes tsho'i bla srog gi 'khor rgyun ldog med cig min par su yis gleng nus/mi rigs shig gi zil rngam srung mkhan nas mi rigs shig gi phyugs skyong gi lag cha bzang po dang / mi rigs shig gi rgyan cha'i mtshon byed 'khrul med cig la 'phos pa'i dus kyi 'gyur ldog dang / lo zla'i char rlung sna tshogs khrod du khyod kyis na zug gi 'khun sgra thengs mang 'chor yod par ma zad/ skyo ngal gyi smreng glu blangs pa bgrang du ga la yod ang /'ur rdo lags/ gna' snga mor khyod nyid dgra lha 'khor ba'i rten dang /wer ma 'bod pa'i g.yab dar/ lha srung dgyes pa'i spyan gzigs/ skyes pa pho yi go mtshon gyi cho lor yang bzhes myong la/ mdzangs ma sman gyi mdzes chas dang / gzhon nu pho mo'i dran rten/ phyugs skyong rdzi bo'i lag cha/ a thig byis pa'i rtsed chas su med thabs med pa'i yo byad cig gi go gnas kyang bzung myong /'ur rdo lags/ mthong snang mdzes pa'i gzi ril mig ma/ rten 'brel legs pa'i phyed mig dgu sgril/ rgyang 'gro bzang ba'i brgyad lhas khra chen/ skyes pa pho yi bcu drug dar lhas/ mdzangs ma mo yi zil mo sgang lhas/ a thig byis pa'i ba ze'i be'u khra/ de ltar sle stangs dang mtshon tshul mi gcig khri ma 'bum 279
byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/gyis 'brog mi'i shes rig dang / blo gros mtshon par byas shing / yid du 'ong ba'i 'ur mthil gyis mi rigs shig gi kha dog gi dga' phyogs mtshon zhing /skad rgyang che ba'i 'ur tshag gis mi rigs shig gi sems gting gi na zug rgyang ring du sgrog pa dang 'dra/kur rdo lags/ khyod kyi tshag skad snyan mo de'i sngun nas sprin dkar dum bu rgyu 'dra'i g.yang khyu dang / dgong chen grib so gug 'dra'i nor gnag gi khyu tshogs kyis mtho sgang gi nyin srib dog mor btang ba lo zla'i rdul phran bzhin bsags yod la/ khyod kyi mdzes sdug gi lang tsho rked pa nas 'phyang 'phrul du bkra ba'i na chung ma dang / khyed kyi zil rngam gyi stobs shugs klad na skor mkhan gyi stag shar ga tshod dang ga tshod yod ang / kho tshos mtho sgang gi steng du mdzes sdug gi khyim gzhis bskrun zhing / brtse mdangs kyi sa bon btab/ brjod mi tshar ba'i lo rgyus dang / blos dpog par dka' ba'i snang brnyan sna tshogs bzheng skrun byas yod/'ur rdo lags/ khyed nyid yul skor sku mgron gyi phyag rtags su gyur nyin 'di sa mtho'i khyad yon 'dzam gling khyon du ngom 'dod yin nam/ 'brog thang gi rnam shes rten med mkha' ru gdengs pa'i snga ltas yin/ rten rdzas bshams mdzod khang nas khyed nyid khu sim mer 'dug nyin 'di dkar nag gi phyugs khyu 'tsho ba'i ngal dub la skabs shig g.yol ba yin nam/ lhas ra gru bzhi'i nang gi g.yang khyu je nyung du 'gro ba'i snga ltas yin/ rtswa thang gi phang ba nas khyed kyi tshag skad snyan mo brag ca'i rjes su yal tshe 'phel rgyas gsar pa zhig gi 280
brtse 'dang gi bzhur rgyun/mgo mo tshe sa pa yin nam/ go la hril po'i 'byung khams khor yug de mi'i rigs kyis 'phel zad 'khrug gsum du btang ba'i nyen brda yin/ kur rdo bzo lugs kyi lag rtsal sus shes 'dri rtsad dgos pa'i dus la bslebs nyin 'di mi rigs kyi lag shes bzo rtsal dmigs med chu la chu bzhag tu thim pa'i sngon rtags shig yin nam/ rtswa thang gi phyi shun nang shun brjes zin pa'i sngon thon 'phrul las kyi dpal yon yang rtser bsnyegs pa'i bzang ltas yin/'ur rdo ya/ gal te khyed nyid rtswa thang gi lo rgyus khang du bshams tshe rtswa thang gi kha dog snga sa nas 'gyur zin cing / rtswa thang gi g.yang khyu stong gsal gzhi dbyings chen mor bzhud zin pa'i rdzogs byang kho nar nges pas/ khyed nyid nam yang rtswa thang gi 'brog phrug ral zing tsho'i glo na dpyang nas 'dug dgos nges red la/ khyed kyi tshag skad snyan mo lhas ra gru bzhi'i mtha' ru nam yang brtan por 'jags dgos nges shig lags/2010 7281
'chi ba/nga tsho 'chi ba la zhe 'tsher don ci yin nam/ phal cher mi yul khams nas nag nyes kyi ri rab brtsegs pa'i gnong 'gyod kyis yin nam/ yang na shi yul khams nas mi yul khams su sprel lad 'khyab pa'i g.yo sgyu'i mjug ma lhang la 'bud par skrag pa e yin/ go thos su gnas de na lkog rngan gyi ltag sgo'i sgo mo 'byed sa med pa'i gshin rje chos rgyal nying 'jags se bzhugs yod skad 'dug la/ rdzun gtam gyi 'khor lo bskor sa med pa'i las kyi bu chung dkar nag gis bden rdzun dbye ba 'byed cing / kha mkhas tshig snyan gyi rna ba sbrid sa med pa'i las mkhan sku lngas bzang ngan gyi brdar sha gcod kyin yod skad 'dug'chi yul ya/ gnas de nas mthon por skyabs rten bcol dgos med la/kha pho che yis zhu sna byed dgos med par drang bden tshul mthun gyi ya rabs mtho ris gnas su 'khrid rkyang dang / mnog rdzun khyam gsum gyi ma rabs 282
brtse 'dang gi bzhur rgyun/dmyal ba'i dong du bskyur rgyu nyag gcig yin par skad/ den na gnas de smru/ bden rdzun gyi brdar sha gcod sa'i drang bden gyi khrims ra gcig pu dang /mtho dman drag zhan med pa'i spyi snyom gyi 'jig rten gcig pu/ g.yo rdzun khyam gsum gyi nag nog ma phog pa'i bste gnas gcig pu ste/ 'jig rten mi yul nas bzang ngan bden rdzun dkar nag gi dbye ba ma chod pa'i 'dri gcod kyi brdar sha gcod sa'i khrims lugs kyi do ra mtha' ma de yin la/ bzang byas ngan smin gyi do mi snyom pa'i spyi tshogs kyi 'gag sgo nas thar ba'i mtha' mjug gi zhing khams gcig pu de lags/khyed tshos soms dang / nga tsho'i mi yul 'dir bzang ngan legs nyes kyi bden rdzun gsal la ma 'dres pa dang / ma yo ma 'khyog par 'byed nus ldan pa'i khrims ra zhig yod tshe dmyal yul gyi gshin rje chos rgyal khu sim mer nga tsho sgug dgos don med cing / bden pa'i gnas lugs kyi ngo bo kho nar skyong ba'i mi yul zhig mchis tshe da gzod zil rngam che ba'i 'chi yul gyi ya gi'i zhing khams dang ma gi'i dmyal khams zhes pa blo ngor bzheng dgos don mi 'dug la/ de bas 'jigs su rung ba'i gshin rje'i khrims ra bzheng skrun byed dgos don ci la yod gang /ngas nam rgyun wa spyang bsdebs pa'i gcan gzan gyi g.yo sgyu'i 'khor lo skor stangs re re dang / khra glag bsdebs pa'i 'dab chags kyi spra lag tshad tshul re re mthong dus sgang gshong snyom pa'i gshin rje yi khrims ra zhes pa de dran 'ong la/ bden rdzun gyi phu thag gcod pa'i dmyal zangs nang gi rgya ma 283
byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/zhes pa yid la 'khor 'ong /nges don du nga tsho 'chi bar ci la skrag ste/ mtho dman mi snyom zhing 'ba' 'bur dang kyag kyog gi bgrod lam dog mo'i mi yul gyi dmyal khams nas brgyud pa'i nga tshos legs nyes ji bzhin 'byed sa'i gshin rje'i khrims ra nas drang bden gyi rgyal kha len chog la/ g.yo sgyu'i zer ma sdang ba'i mi yul gyi rlung kha nas phog pa'i dka' sdug gi rma kha de dag bden don kho nar rgyal kha ster ba'i gshin rje'i khrims ra nas sos chog ang /'on kyang / nga tsho 'chi ba la skrag cing / 'chi rgyur shin tu zhed pa ni 'chi ba kho nar skrag pa min par/ nag nyes can zhig khrims rar 'gro ba dang 'dra bar mi yul nas bsags pa'i rang byas kyi nyes pa mthug po der skrag pa yin la/ bzang po ngan pa'i gzugs su bskrun zhing / ngan pa bzang po'i gzugs su bskrun mkhan gyi kha dmar nang gi lce dmar de dang / g.yo sgyu'i 'khor lo bskor zhing / brnag sems gnod sems kyi me lces bsregs pa'i nag thul thul gyi sems nag sol ba'i rdog po de nges par 'khur dgos yod pas yin pa 'dra/2009 8284
mjug byang /mi tshe'i bshug lam ring mo de nas 'tsho ba'i bde sdug mngar skyur kha gsum du myong gin dga' sdang gi zhen 'dzin nam mkha'i sprin tshogs kyi 'du 'god la 'gran pa'i nang sems kyi dungs pa dang / brtse ba/ sdang ba sna tshogs dbyangs su gyer ba ni smyug thogs pa tsho'i rang gshis shig yin/ bgrod mi tshar ba'i bshul lam ring mo de dang brjod mi tshar ba'i bde sdug gi myong ba zab mo de dag snyan ngag pa la mtshon na dga' 'dzum khog la mi shong ba'i spro skyid kyi zhing khams shig yin la/ skyo gdung gi ngal bas mnar ba'i mi yul gyi dmyal khams ring mo zhig kyang yin te/ snyan ngag pa ni nang sems kyi dga' skyo'i tshor 'du shugs drag che bas so/ /snyan ngag pa zhig la yod dgos pa ni mi gshis drang mo zhig dang / 'tsho ba'i dga' skyo chags sdang lhad med pa zhig spyi tshogs kyi bde sdug kun la bsgrag phod pa zhig drang bden dang g.yo rdzun gyi phyi shun nang shun dbral mkhas pa zhig rang sems kyi 'dod don gzhan gyis 285
byang thang gi bzhur rgyun/bsgyur mi btub pa zhig bcas yin mod/ rnyog 'dzing che ba'i spyi tshogs kyi 'gal 'brel khrod snyan ngag pa mang po zhig rang sems bag la nyal ba'i gzhan gyi mgrin tshab pa dang / spyi tshogs kyi bde sdug rnal ma lhang la 'phud rgyur gzur nas 'gro mkhan du 'gyur 'gro bar yang thabs shes ci zhig yod de ha cang nyam chung ba'i kho bo cag la mi chen gyi sdang mig dang / khram pa'i khrel dgod/ g.yon ma'i mi kha/ skyes bu phal gyis bzang bshad ngan bshad sogs ri mgo mthon po'i steng gi lhags rlung ltar sdang bzhin yod pas so/ / rang nyid kyang dga' sdang gi 'du shes 'char myur ba'i sems pa de snyan ngag pa la dgos pa'i mi gshis dang mthun par snyam nas lhug rtsom gtso bor byas pa'i rtsom yig mang po zhig bris pa yin mod/ de dag gis ni khyed cag klog pa po rnams la mos lhang lhang gi slob ston legs po zhig dang /ljid tig tig gi sems 'gul zab mo zhig ci la thebs srid de/ tha na rang nyid la'ang yid tshims pa'i snyan ngag legs po zhig da bar gtan nas 'khyongs myong med do/ / 'on te/ rang gi nang sems pa'i gdung ba lci mo de dag shog thog tu sgrog par dga' ba'i 'gyur med kyi gshis rgyud des bskul nas da lam2005lo'i tshun du bris pa'i lhug rtsom00lhag tsam gyi nang nas legs pa'i gras rnams phyogs bsdus kyis par du bskrun pa yin/snyan rtsom de dag gis gsar zhen pa rnams la rnying drags pa dang / rnying zhen pa rnams la gsar drags pa/ go dka' bar mos pa rnams la mtshon na snyan ngag gi ro nyams bral zhing / go sla bar mos pa rnams nas brjod don 286
mjug byang /'phral du mi rtogs sogs skyon cha mang po zhig bstar nges par ma zad/ rang rang gi sems khams dang mi mthun pa'i brjod don gyi cha'ang mthong nges lags rung / 'tsho ba'i dga' sdang gi brjod don ni khyod la mtshon na dgos med du mthong yang / rang la mtshon na ches gal chen dgos yod cig chags srid pas rang sems dang gzhan sems kyi dga' sdang 'dzin phyogs la bsam gzhig legs pos bzang ngan gyi gong thang 'phral du mi gcod par dkyel yangs zab mo gnang rogs zhu/'on kyang / nar ma son pa'i rmongs rtul gyi bsam blo dang / sbyong brdar zhan pa'i smyug rtse'i 'gros rtsub mo des brjod bya rjod byed gang thad nas zhe mer ldang ba'i skyon cha 'byung srid la/ tha na rtsom thung 'ga' zhig la lad zlos kyi cha'am rtsom nyams glu brgya gdangs gcig gi rnam pa'ang yod srid pas ma 'dang ba'i nyes skyon kun la blo gzu bor gnas pa'i dag sel gyi dgag bzhag brag steng gi rbab chu ltar 'phyo bar sems gting nas dang len zhu/mtshams 'dir mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gi〈〈sgrang char〉〉rtsom sgrig pa yongs dang / lhag par dpe deb 'di nyid kyi rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur pa chos skyong lags nas thugs khur rgyab skyor bsam gyis mi khyab pa gnang bar bka' drin shin tu che zhes zhu rgyu yin/zhes rtsom po pos byang thang nag chu shel tsā'i 'brog grong nas/2011lo'i zla12par/287
